blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Frontier language-model agents can now improve robots on their own: they write control code, test it, and keep what works as skills and memories for the next task. We introduce SEAR (Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics), a framework and benchmark built around two questions. Is the agent really learning, or just trying more often? And does what it learns still help on new tasks, in a new simulator, and on a real robot? The framework runs an agent in three modes: it writes code that becomes the policy (code-as-policy), acts live in the control loop (agent-as-policy), or works as a researcher that fine-tunes a vision-language-action model (auto-research). The benchmark adds controls that separate retained experience from repeated attempts, familiar tasks, privileged simulator state, larger budgets, and luck. Across seven frontier language models, 330 simulated and five physical tasks, and over four years of agent runtime, we highlight three findings. First, the learning curve of a robotic agent depends both on the overall time budget and the task difficulty relative to model capability. Harder tasks make longer sessions worthwhile; on easier tasks, re-rolling short attempts does just as well. Second, control code and shared routines transfer across tasks and simulators, while task-specific solutions do not. On a real robot, we observe a performance gap between agent-designed practice and novel human-designed scenes. Third, different models evolve more effectively in different ways. Some do best acting live, others writing code first. And a text-only model keeps pace with a comparable multimodal one: perception helps with error assessment, but agentic reasoning and tool use can matter more. We release the benchmark and codebase to support future research.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language-model (LM) agents can now improve robots on their own. Given a task and a way to check success, a coding agent writes a control program, runs it, reads what went wrong, and revises the program. It can save what worked as a skill for the next task, or collect its own rollouts and fine-tune a vision-language-action model (VLA) on them. Recent systems run this self-improvement loop in simulation and on real robots ( Fu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Waddle Labs, 2026 ) . Robots need this ability because, once deployed, they meet objects, conditions, and tasks that no one prepared them for, and no engineer is there to rewrite their programs.
blocks.zh: 语言模型(LM)代理现在可以自行改进机器人. 鉴于一个任务和检查成功的方法,一个编码代理写一个控制程序,运行它,读出出错的东西,并修改程序. 它可以节省作为下一项任务的一种技能,或者收集自己的推出,并在它们上微调一个视觉语言-行动模型。 最近的系统在模拟和在真正的机器人上运行这种自我改进循环(Fu等,2026;Zhang等,2026a; Lu等,2026; Xiao等,2026; Waddle Labs, 2026). 机器人需要这种能力,因为一旦部署,它们就满足了无人准备的物体、条件和任务,没有工程师可以重写程序。

blocks.en: A rising success rate, however, is not proof that the agent learned. We ask two questions. Is the agent really learning, or just trying more often? A rising curve can come from resampling, since more independent attempts solve more problems ( Brown et al., 2024 ) , or from one lucky run, a larger budget, or simulator state a real robot never sees. And does what it learns still help elsewhere? A held-out initial state of the practiced task is the smallest possible step away from practice. Experience that is worth keeping should also help on new tasks, in a new simulator, and on a real robot. Prior systems each define their own protocol, so their results cannot answer either question or be compared with one another.
blocks.zh: 然而,成功率的上升并不能证明代理人学到了什么。 我们提出两个问题。 特工真的在学习 还是经常尝试? 上升曲线可以来自再生,因为更多的独立尝试可以解决更多的问题(Brown等,2024年),或者来自一个幸运跑道,更大的预算,或者模拟器状态一个真正的机器人从未见过. 它所学的东西在别处还有帮助吗? 实践任务的初步状态是远离实践的最小一步。 值得保留的经验也应有助于完成新的任务、新的模拟器和真正的机器人。 先前的系统各自定义自己的协议,因此它们的结果无法回答问题或相互比较.

blocks.en: We introduce SEAR ( S elf- E volving A gentic R obotics ), a framework and benchmark for answering both ( Section 2 ). The framework runs an LM agent through one harness in simulation and on hardware, in three modes: the agent writes a program that becomes the policy (code-as-policy), stays in the control loop and acts live (agent-as-policy), or fine-tunes a VLA on rollouts it collects (auto-research). In code-as-policy, the policy usually contains no learned action model: the LM writes ordinary Python that calls perception, inverse-kinematics, and servo tools. A pretrained VLA is also in the toolbox, but almost no final program uses it ( Section 5.2 ). Between tasks the agent keeps a library of code skills and written memories. Figure 2 shows the loop and a few physical tasks being learned this way. The benchmark pairs every comparison with a control. Three short restarts at the same total budget (best-of-3) and a run with no library separate learning from resampling. A sealed judge grades frozen policies on initial states the agent never sees. Repeated runs expose luck. Five generalization tiers measure how far a gain reaches.

blocks.en:
We use SEAR to study seven frontier LMs on 330 simulated tasks in two physics engines and five physical tasks, with over four years of agent runtime in total. Three findings stand out: • The agents learn, but not always ( Section 3 ). The learning curve of a robotic agent depends both on the overall time budget and the task difficulty relative to model capability. Harder tasks make longer sessions worthwhile; on easier tasks, re-rolling short attempts does just as well.
An inherited library helps most where a model succeeds sometimes but not reliably on its own. It adds little when the model almost always fails or almost always succeeds without it. On RoboLab, GPT-5.6-sol scores 46.9% with no library, 42.4% with its own library, and 60.6% with another model’s library, so experience saved as code transfers across models. A library can also be harmful when brittle skills or outright mistakes are carried forward. • Code and shared routines transfer; task-specific solutions do not ( Section 4 ). Grasp and control routines carry across tasks and simulators, and one program, written before the agent is told its tasks, succeeds on scenes it never explored when its routines work there. Code policies keep working under hardware faults that do not move the camera, and a trained VLA keeps working when the camera is moved. On a real robot, success in practice overstates success on new scenes. • The LM matters, and so does how it likes to act ( Section 5 ). The strongest model leads every simulated family, and the gap between models widens as tasks get harder. A text-only model beats a multimodal model with the same general-capability score on the hardest family, RoboLab, with and without a library. On hardware, GPT-6-astra more than doubles its score when it acts live (from 41% to 88%), but acting live is slow: a live episode takes a median of 12.8 minutes of robot time, against 3.8 for a frozen code policy. Fable 5.1, placed in the live loop, writes and runs scripts for almost every command, and scores about the same either way.

blocks.en: 2 SEAR : Framework and Benchmark
blocks.zh: 2 SEAR:框架和基准

blocks.en: 2.1 Three Ways to Run an Agent
blocks.zh: 2.1 运行代理人的三种方法

blocks.en: SEAR organizes LM-driven robot learning ( Fu et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) by what the agent produces and what runs on the robot ( Figure 2 ): • Code-as-policy (CaP). The agent writes a program, and the program is the policy. No LM runs at execution time, so the policy is fast, and it can be replayed and re-graded without the agent. • Agent-as-policy (AaP). The LM stays in the control loop and chooses each command from live observations. Every command waits on a model call, so episodes are slower and evaluation costs grow with each rollout. • Auto-research (AR). The agent runs training experiments on another model ( Rank et al., 2026 ) : it collects rollouts from code policies it treats as teachers, curates them, fine-tunes the VLA π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Black et al., 2025 ) , evaluates it, and decides what to try next. Every agent starts from the same toolbox: SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) for segmentation, a pretrained π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , and inverse-kinematics and servo interfaces. Each task starts in a fresh workspace. What persists from task to task is the library : versioned code skills and written memories harvested from the best policy of each finished task. AR checkpoints and data never carry over to the next task. Only skills and memories do. Simulation experiments use CaP and AR, because a judge can cheaply re-grade their frozen outputs. The hardware experiments also use AaP. Table 1 places existing systems in this space.

blocks.en: 2.4 Protocol
blocks.zh: 2.4 议定书

blocks.en: Sealed judge. The agent works in its own container, where it can run local simulations, inspect failures, install packages, and train checkpoints. When the budget ends or the agent submits, its policy is frozen, and only the frozen program with its imported skills, or the AR checkpoint, is passed to a separate judge. The judge holds the held-out initial states and the grading logic, and ignores any success the policy claims. Each randomized task splits its initial states into DEV seeds the agent uses freely, VAL seeds the judge grades and reports back during development, and TEST seeds graded once at the end. Every reported simulation score is the TEST success rate over ten rollouts per task, and learning curves use VAL scores. Agents still found ways around the seal, such as reading object geometry from asset files; Section A.9 lists them.
blocks.zh: 封为判官. 代理商在自己的集装箱内工作,在那里可以进行局部模拟,检查故障,安装包裹,并训练出检查站. 当预算结束或代理提交时,其政策被冻结,只有具有所引进技能的被冻结程序,或AR检查点,才转给单独的法官. 法官持有被搁置的初始状态和分级逻辑,无视政策主张的任何成功. 每个随机化的任务将其初始状态分解为该剂自由使用的DEV种子,VAL种子在开发过程中评分和上报,TEST种子在开发后一次分级. 每一个报告的模拟分数是TEST成功率超过每个任务的10个推出,学习曲线使用VAL分数. 特工们仍然在封地周围找到方法,例如从资产文件中读取物体几何;A.9节列出了它们.

blocks.en: Conditions. Vanilla starts every task with an empty library. Lineage is the same setup, but the agent inherits and extends its library task after task. Best-of-3 splits a Vanilla session’s budget into three fresh attempts and keeps the one with the best VAL score. A code-as-policy session gets one hour per task (two on RoboLab). AR gets the same total development time for each suite, a group of tasks within a family. Each condition runs three times per model, except AR on LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboLab (one run). Self-exploration withholds the instruction and the judge: the agent practices on the scenes with its inherited library, proposes its own tasks, and only then sees the instruction and writes one final policy.
blocks.zh: 条件 香草从一个空的库开始每一项任务. 线程是相同的设置,但代理继承和任务后延长其库任务. 最佳3人将香草会的预算分成了三次新的尝试,并保持了VAL评分最好的一个. 一个守则-政策会话每个任务一个小时(两个关于RoboLab). AR每套套房获得相同的总开发时间,一组家庭内的任务. 每个条件每个型号运行三次,但LIBERO上的AR,LIBERO-PRO,和RoboLab(一跑)除外. 自我探索扣留了指令和法官:在现场的代理惯例与其所继承的图书馆,提出自己的任务,而后才看到指令并写出一个最终政策.

blocks.en: Generalization tiers. T1 new initial states of the practiced task; T2 the same tasks under changed conditions (LIBERO-PRO scenes, LIBERO-RIG hardware faults), run with frozen policies and no further practice; T3 new tasks in the same simulator, after self-exploration; T4 a new simulator and action API (MuJoCo to RoboLab’s Isaac Sim), after self-exploration; T5 the physical robot.

blocks.en: Physical protocol. On hardware nothing resets itself, so each task comes with a reset task the agent must also learn (take the banana out of the bowl, scramble the letters). An external evaluator judges before-and-after images, and practice stops after ten consecutive successes (Block Stacking has no early stop) or at a 12-hour budget per task. The frozen policy is then run once on each of ten scenes staged by an operator (five scenes for AaP, whose episodes are slower). The operator confirms the evaluator’s verdict.
blocks.zh: 物理协议。 在硬件上,没有任何东西自己重排,所以每个任务都伴随着一个重置的任务,代理者也必须学习(从碗中取出香蕉,将字母打出). 一名外部评价员在图像之前和之后进行评断,在连续十次成功后(Block Stacking没有提前停止)或在每次任务12小时的预算下停止练习。 冰冻政策随后由接线员所出演的10个场景各运行一次(AaP的5个场景,其出场速度更慢). 经营者确认评估者的裁决。

blocks.en: 3 Is It Learning, or Just Trying More?
blocks.zh: 3 是学习还是只是尝试更多?

blocks.en: Finding Agents do learn from their own experience, but simpler explanations account for part of the rise in success. Splitting a session into three short attempts does as well as one long session when the model succeeds early. The long session wins only when a short attempt would end before the first success. An inherited library helps most when a model succeeds sometimes but not reliably on its own. It adds little when the model almost always fails or almost always succeeds. What it adds depends on what it contains: a useful skill raises success on later tasks, and a wrong belief saved in it is passed on to later tasks too.
blocks.zh: 寻找代理人的确从自己的经验中吸取了教训,但简单的解释说明了成功率上升的部分原因. 将一个会话分成三个简短的尝试,当模型早期成功时,一个长会话也一样。 只有短暂的尝试在第一次成功之前结束,长会才能获胜。 当一个模型有时成功但不能可靠地靠自己时,一个被继承的库最有帮助. 当模型几乎总是失败或几乎总是成功时,它几乎没有增加什么. 它增加的内容取决于它包含的内容:有用的技能可以提高后期任务的成功率,所保存的错误信念也会被传递给后期任务.

blocks.en: The results below depend on which language model drives the agent. The library helps most for models that do moderately well without it: a weak model writes little worth saving, and a strong model has little left to gain ( Section 5.1 ). We first separate learning from trying more often, then ask what the library adds.

blocks.en: Best-of-3 is the fair version of trying more often: three fresh attempts at a third of the budget, keeping the one with the best validation score. On robosuite, the easiest family, one hour beats three 20-minute attempts for Opus (93.8 against 90.0% TEST; Table 16 ) and, on validation, for every model but Gemini-3.6-flash, which is level ( Table 15 ). On RoboLab, the hardest, the sign of the session term depends on the model, and it follows one quantity ( Table 5 ): when the model first succeeds. GPT-5.6-sol and Gemini-3.6-flash reach their first validation success at a median of 21 and 36 minutes, inside a 40-minute attempt, so each of the three attempts gets past the first success, and best-of-3 beats one two-hour session by 1.6 and 2.8 points. Opus and DeepSeek-v4-flash 1 1 1 DeepSeek-v4-flash’s RoboLab runs with a library cover only the first 58 tasks: they stopped when the API provider retired the model. On LIBERO-RIG, DeepSeek is DeepSeek-v4.1-flash. need about an hour, and Kimi-k3 nearly an hour and a half. A 40-minute attempt ends before their first success, and splitting costs them 5 to 24 points. Part of that cost is that short attempts often end without submitting a policy: Kimi-k3 submits a policy in 10% of its 40-minute attempts against 68% of its two-hour runs. Under LIBERO-RIG’s hidden faults the session term is the largest in the study, 66 points for Opus, whose first success comes at a median of 28 minutes, after a 20-minute attempt has ended. Task difficulty alone therefore does not decide which setup is better. What decides it is the model’s time to first success compared with the length of one short attempt. The same holds averaged over all five families ( Figure 5 ): only GPT-5.6-sol reaches its first success inside a short attempt, and it gains 2.9 points from the long session, against 14.5 to 31.9 for the other four models.

blocks.zh: 3.2 一些模式的经验载体

blocks.en: The library helps most in the middle. How much the library adds depends less on which model inherits it than on how well that model does on a family without one ( Figure 6 ; Figure 4 gives each model’s curves). Over the 25 model–family pairs of Table 6 , it adds 0.9 points on average where the model already scores above 80% without it (Opus and GPT-5.6-sol on every family but RoboLab), 12.0 points between 30 and 80%, and 3.0 below 30% (Gemini-3.6-flash and DeepSeek-v4-flash on RoboLab). Above 80%, there is little left to gain. Below 30%, the model rarely reuses what it saved: DeepSeek-v4-flash imports library code in 20% of its RoboLab policies, Gemini-3.6-flash calls most of its skills once, and Inkling-small, a sixth simulation model that we withdrew from the comparison, held 0 to 6 skills after 47 tasks ( Appendix O ). Between 30 and 80%, the gains are large: the library lifts Gemini-3.6-flash by 46.6 points under LIBERO-RIG’s faults, and Kimi-k3 from 30.1 to 51.9% on RoboLab, above GPT-5.6-sol with or without a library. Where the library does not change the final score, it still reaches that score sooner: on LIBERO-RIG, Opus and GPT-5.6-sol reach their final score by 30 minutes (96 and 89% on validation), while their runs without a library are still at 75 and 81%. These gains are larger than a rerun’s noise: comparing each Lineage run with a held-out Vanilla repetition over 1,510 model–task pairs puts the library’s help at 8 to 10 points, both on tasks the model never solved alone and on tasks it did ( Table 7 ). The one pair between 30 and 80% where the library hurts, GPT-5.6-sol on RoboLab (46.9 to 42.4%), shows that what the library holds matters as much as how well the model does without it.

blocks.en: What the library holds matters. Figure 7 shows a useful inherited skill: one skill, written on an earlier task, turns a failed grasp into a reliable one. Kimi-k3’s library fills with such routines (gripper control from measured opening, yaw alignment, pinch grasps), and its gain grows as they accumulate. GPT-5.6-sol’s library holds mostly object-location recipes and few grasp checks. In inspected failures, it reuses thresholds and offsets from earlier tasks and keeps tuning them after they fail on a new scene. To separate the library’s content from the model, we give GPT-5.6-sol libraries written by other models. On RoboLab, GPT-5.6-sol scores 46.9% without a library and 42.4% with its own, but 60.6% with the library Opus wrote and 55.7% with Kimi-k3’s (three runs over all 105 tasks for each donor library). The model is the same, and only the inherited library differs. Experience saved as code and notes can transfer between models.
blocks.zh: 图书馆有什么问题。 图7显示了一种有用的继承技能:一种技能,写在较早的任务上,将一个失败的抓取转化为可靠的. Kimi-k3 的库中充满了这样的常规(从量度开口、 yaw 校正、 抓取) , 其收益随着积累而增加。 GPT-5.6-sol的图书馆主要保存对象定位的食谱, 在被检查的故障中,它会再用阈值并抵消先前的任务,并在新场景出故障后不断调整. 为了将图书馆的内容与模型区分开来,我们给其他模型所写的GPT-5.6-sol图书馆. 在RoboLab上,GPT-5.6-sol的成绩是46.9%没有图书馆,42.4%有自己的图书馆,但60.6%的图书馆Opus写作,55.7%的Kimi-k3的图书馆(每个捐赠图书馆有三所全部105个任务)。 模型相同,只有被继承的图书馆不同. 作为代码和注释保存的经验可以在模型之间转移.

blocks.en: 3.3 What Carries Forward Includes Mistakes
blocks.zh: 3.3 运输工具包括错误

blocks.en: Nothing in the loop requires a saved lesson to be checked again, so errors persist like skills do. In self-exploration, where the agent has no judge and must build its own success detector, one Opus run built a placement verifier in its first session, calibrated on sixteen episodes whose three failures happened not to move at all. The verifier declared success on 699 later rollouts and was wrong on 91% of them. Because its verdict was also the stopping rule, 637 rollouts ended without another grasp attempt. The run saved the verdict in memory as a fact, and every later session inherited it. The run scored 4.6% overall. Its two sibling runs, identical in setup but without that verifier, scored 15.5 and 23.6%, three to five times higher. Runs with the same setup often end far apart: two DeepSeek-v4-flash Lineage runs differed by 20.9 points with two tasks flipping between 0 and 100, and on LIBERO the library moves Opus and GPT-5.6-sol by less than a run’s standard deviation (94.4 against 95.2% and 88.3 against 87.1%). A single run cannot be told apart from luck, so SEAR reports the spread over three runs.
blocks.zh: 循环中没有任何东西需要再次检查保存的教训,因此错误像技能一样持续存在. 在自我探索中,在特工没有判断力,必须自己建造成功探测器的地方,一个奥普斯跑在首个赛会中建造了定位验证器,校正了16个赛事,其中3个出事时完全不动. 核查员在后来的699年推出时宣布成功,其中91%的成绩出错. 由于它的判决也是"停止规则",637个推出时没有再尝试把握. 跑跑将判决保存在了记忆中作为一个事实,而后每届都继承了这个事实. 运行总成绩为4.6%. 它的两只兄弟会跑步,布局相同,但没有那个核查员,得分分别为15.5%和23.6%,高了3到5倍. 使用相同设置的运行往往会相去甚远:两道DeepSeek-v4-flash 线性运行有20.9分之差,有两个任务在0-100之间翻转,在LIBERO上,库将Opus和GPT-5.6-sol移动不到跑道的标准差(94.4比95.2%,88.3比87.1%)。 一次跑步除了运气之外是无法得知的,所以SEAR报告这三次跑步的分布.

blocks.en: 4 Does What It Learns Transfer?
blocks.zh: 4 它学到了什么转移?

blocks.en: Finding Success falls as the test moves further from what the agent practiced. The parts of the library that still help are the general ones: control code, grasp routines, and shared parsing, not solutions written for one task. Code policies cope with hardware faults they can observe, but fail when the camera moves. A VLA trained inside the loop loses some success when the camera moves instead of failing outright, but it matches code only on families where its code teacher produces many successful demonstrations to train on. On a real robot, success in practice overstates success in the test: during practice the agent resets the scene itself and rarely creates the hard starting states that an operator sets up for the test.
blocks.zh: 寻找成功取决于测试与代理人实践的更进一步。 库中仍然有帮助的部分是一般的:控制代码,抓取常规,以及共享解析,而不是为一个任务所写的解决方案. 代码政策处理他们可以观察到的硬件故障,但在相机移动时失败. 当摄影机移动而不是彻底失败时, 接受过循环训练的VLA会失去一些成功, 但是它只符合家庭密码, 在真正的机器人上,实践上的成功会过度地描述测试中的成功:在练习中,代理将场景本身重排,很少产生操作员为测试设定的硬起步状态.

blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 向下泛化层

blocks.en: 4.2 One Program, New Scenes
blocks.zh: 4.2 一个方案,新情景

blocks.en: The libraries are reused across tasks and simulators. On the first half of RoboLab, Opus’s three lineages imported 202 distinct skills 660 times, and skills written on the MuJoCo families were imported by about half of its RoboLab policies (two fifths for Kimi-k3, almost none for the other three models). The skills reused across simulators are control code, such as servo wrappers and grasp routines, not task solutions. One rim-pinch skill, written on LIBERO because a bowl was wider than the gripper, was imported by 66 later policies; RoboLab’s four spatial-relation tasks were solved 10 of 10 on first contact, in all three lineages, by libraries that already held LIBERO’s spatial skills and a memory that relation words name regions of the table ( Appendix P ).
blocks.zh: 图书馆被跨任务和模拟器重用. 在RoboLab的上半期,奥普斯的三行人进口了202个独特的技能660次,而写在MujoCo家族上的技能则被其大约一半的RoboLab政策所进口(Kimi-k3的五分之二,其他三种模式几乎没有)。 跨模拟器再利用的技能是控制代码,如伺服包装和抓取常规,而不是任务解决方案. 一个Rim-pinch技能,写在LIBERO上,因为一碗比抓取器宽,后来有66个政策被导入;RoboLab的4个空间关系任务在第一次接触时被10分之10解决了,在所有三个行中,都由已经拥有LIBERO空间技能的图书馆以及一个将表上单词取名区域的记忆(附录P).

blocks.en: Figure 8: One task-general program serves an explored and a never-explored scene. A self-exploration lineage, never told its tasks, ends with one program that parses each instruction into a goal and calls shared routines. “Put the bigger pumpkin in the bin”, in a scene the lineage never explored, calls the same grasp and placement as an explored banana-into-bowl task, and rises from 0 to 7 of 10 as those routines improve elsewhere.
blocks.zh: 图 8:一个任务总程序服务于一个被探索和从未探索过的场景. 自我探索的行由,从未告诉它的任务,以一个程序结束,将每个指令分解成一个目标并调用共享的常规. “把大南瓜放入垃圾桶”,在世系从未探索过的场景中,称其掌握和布置与所探索的香蕉进肚任务相同,随着这些例行工作在其他地方有所改善,从10分之0上升到7分。

blocks.en: A program written without knowing the task works on new scenes when the routines it needs already work. In self-exploration, the agent gets neither task instructions nor a judge. It proposes its own practice and learns to map instructions onto common goals and reusable routines ( Figure 8 ). We froze one Opus lineage’s task-general program at four points along its RoboLab sequence and graded each, unchanged, on one task per scene ( Figure 16 ). Success on the same 44 tasks rises from 15.5 to 31.6%, and on twelve scenes the lineage never explored, from 5.8 to 22.5%. The gain follows the routines: at the last checkpoint, never-explored tasks that need only routines that already work somewhere average 52%, and those that need a routine never shown to work, such as removing an object from a container, average 1%. Improvement concentrates in grasping: grasp failures fall from 58 to 29% of graded episodes. When the instruction is finally disclosed, one rewrite adds a consistent margin over the frozen program: it is better in all 21 lineages of each of Opus, GPT-5.6-sol, and Kimi-k3 (median gains 7.8, 10.4, and 7.1 points; Table 14 ).
blocks.zh: 一个程序写作时不知道任务在新的场景上起作用,当它需要的常规已经起作用了. 在自我探索中,代理人既得不到任务指示,也得不到法官. 它提出了自己的做法并学会将指示映射到共同目标和可重复使用的常规上(图8)。 我们冻结了一个Opus家族任务总程序, 沿RoboLab序列四分之一, 同样44个任务的成功率从15.5%上升到31.6%,在12个场景中,家族从未探索过,从5.8%上升到22.5%。 收益遵循了常规:在上一个检查站,从未探索过的任务,这些任务只需要在某个地方已经正常工作的常规,平均为52%;而那些需要常规的则从未显示工作,如从容器中取出物体,平均为1%. 改进集中在把握:把握失败率从58%下降到29%。 在最后披露指令时,一次重写会比被冻结的程序增加一个一致的比分:在Opus、GPT-5.6-sol和Kimi-k3的所有21个行中,它都更好(中间增益为7.8、10.4和7.1分;表14)。

blocks.en: Weights match code where demonstrations are plentiful. On LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO the VLA scores within two points of code (94.0 vs. 94.4 and 90.6 vs. 91.8%) and matches or beats it on about four tasks in five. It falls well short on robosuite (61.0 vs. 97.1) and RoboLab (47.2 vs. 68.0; Table 8 ). The limit is the number of demonstrations: RoboLab’s slow simulator yields about one seventh as many teacher episodes per agent-hour as LIBERO. RoboLab tasks with fewer than 50 successful demonstrations score 20.8% against 94.0% with 300 or more ( Table 25 ). The learning curves show the same split over session time ( Figure 10 ). The student rarely exceeds its teacher ( Figure 9 a): of the 11 tasks whose teacher solves no TEST state, the VLA succeeds on at least one TEST state in 2 of them.

blocks.en: Weights survive a moved camera; code does not. A code policy turns pixels into world coordinates through an assumed camera pose. When the scene camera moves, nothing in the program checks that pose, and the LM that wrote the program is not running at test time to notice. Code falls to 9%, while the VLA keeps 69% ( Figure 9 b). Under the seven faults that leave the scene camera in place, the code policy re-detects the object before each move and holds 90%. The VLA also handles new instructions better: trained on its own self-exploration data, where 95% of episodes carry a distinct instruction, it reaches 42.6 and 43.6% on held-out LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO tasks, level with or above the code policy written after the task instruction is disclosed (41.7 and 24.9%).
blocks.zh: 重量在移动相机后幸存;代码没有. 密码政策通过假想相机姿势将像素转化为世界坐标. 当场景相机移动时,程序检查中没有任何显示,写程序的LM没有在测试时间运行以引起注意. 代码降至9%,而VLA保留了69%(图9b). 在将场景相机留在原地的7个断层下,代码政策在每次移动前重新检测对象并持有90%. 志愿军还更好地处理新的指示:根据自己的自我探索数据培训,95%的节目有不同的指示,在被搁置的LIBERO和LIBERO-PRO任务中达到42.6%和43.6%,在任务指示披露后,与或高于密码政策的水平(41.7%和24.9%)。

blocks.en: The two kinds of agent attend to different things. Code agents open rendered images in 84 to 96% of sessions; only 10 of 40 inspected VLA sessions ever look at a rollout of the policy they train. Two thirds of code agents’ memories concern grasp and contact, while over a third of VLA agents’ memories concern the training recipe ( Table 10 ). Code agents mostly debug how the robot interacts with objects. VLA agents mostly debug the training pipeline.
blocks.zh: 此二种通相随事. 在84%至96%的课程中,密码员打开了图像;在40个被检查的志愿军课程中,只有10个看过他们培训的政策的推出。 三分之二的密码代理人的记忆涉及抓取和接触,三分之一以上的志愿军代理人的记忆涉及培训方法(表10)。 代码代理大多是调试机器人与物体互动的方式. VLA特工大多调试训练管道.

blocks.en: Ten practice successes in a row do not guarantee a high held-out score. Six practice runs reached ten successes in a row, which ends practice. only one of them, Fable’s Push-T, then succeeded on all ten staged scenes, and two (Fable’s Spell SEAR, Opus’s Cup Upright) succeeded on only four. The reason is that the agent’s own resets choose the states it practices on ( Figure 11 c). Only 10 of Opus’s 64 practice Push-T starts required turning the T by more than 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} , against 6 of the 10 staged scenes. Fable’s reset, which scrambles the letters, never left a letter farther than 0.48 m from an arm, but 2 staged Spell SEAR scenes did. A streak measured on states of the agent’s own making can end practice before the hard states ever appear.
blocks.zh: 连续十次实践成功并不能保证高收分. 六个实践连续十次取得成功,结束了实践。 只有其中之一,Fable's Push-T,然后在所有十出舞台上获得成功,而两出(Fable's Spell SEAR,Opus's Cup Upright)仅以四出成功. 原因是代理商自己重新选择它所操作的状态(图11c). Opus的64个练习中只有10个Push-T开始需要将T翻转90多分 90-Circ}与10个舞台剧中的6个相对. Fable的重置使字母相去甚远, 以代理商自己制造的状态来衡量的运行过程,可以在困难状态出现之前结束实践。

blocks.en: Frozen policies fail at limits the agents set themselves. We audited all 116 failed or partial evaluation outcomes; no scene was physically impossible, since each was solved by another agent, by the same agent in the other mode, or lay within measured reach. In 29 of 34 for Fable, 32 of 35 for Opus, and 26 of 47 for GPT-6-astra, the policy stopped at a limit, rule, or motion the agent had chosen itself, typically after a single incident in practice. Fable, for example, set a reach limit of 0.49 m with a vertical gripper, while tilting the gripper by 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} reaches 0.56 m. The two staged scenes beyond its limit fail ( Appendix K ). A lesson learned once becomes a rule, and nothing in the loop tests it again.

blocks.en: The loop runs on a second embodiment. We ported the harness to a Sharpa Wave hand with 22 joints on a Flexiv arm, sharing no hardware with the two-arm rig. A Fable 5.1 agent learned to type random digits on a physical numpad at over five keys per second within 2.5 hours, and typed the first 100 digits of π \pi three times at 5.1 keys per second with one wrong digit in total across the three runs ( Figure 12 ); the learned typing policy also plays a short melody on a piano keyboard ( project website ). The agent learned on this hand alone, on hardware only. An accurate simulated twin of the hand later proved hard to build. The demonstration therefore shows that the harness can be moved to a new robot, not that skills transfer between robots.

blocks.en: 5 What the Language Model Brings
blocks.zh: 页:1 语言模型带来什么

blocks.en: Finding The language model sets how well the robot does: the strongest model leads on every family, and the gap between models widens as tasks get harder. What separates models is not whether they can see. A text-only model that reaches the scene through segmentation and depth tools can beat a multimodal model. Images help mainly with debugging. Models also have preferred ways to act, and the best mode for one model is not the best for another.
blocks.zh: 查找 语言模型设定了机器人的成绩:最强的模型带领着每个家族,随着任务更艰巨,模型间的差距会扩大. 区别在于模型是否能看到。 通过分块和深度工具到达场景的仅文本模型可以击败多模式模型. 图像主要帮助调试. 模型也更喜欢行动方式,一个模型的最佳模式不是另一个模型的最佳模式.

GPT-5.6-sol is second on every family without a library. With a library, Kimi-k3 overtakes it on robosuite, LIBERO-RIG, and RoboLab. The ranking follows general capability. On the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index ( Artificial Analysis, 2026 ) (high reasoning setting; Figure 13 b), Opus scores 48, GPT-5.6-sol 47, Kimi-k3 44, and Gemini-3.6-flash and DeepSeek-v4-flash 34 each. One Inkling-small run went 29 tasks in a row without a valid policy, so it had nothing to save in its library, and we withdrew the model ( Appendix O ). blocks.en: 5.2 Seeing Is Not the Bottleneck
blocks.zh: 5.2 见不是波特伦克

blocks.en: A natural guess is that manipulation rewards the model that can see. Our results do not support this guess. DeepSeek-v4-flash is text-only, yet it combines the tools in its toolbox into working manipulation policies: nearly all of its RoboLab policies ask SAM3 for a mask of the named object and use the depth image to turn that mask into a 3-D position, and it produces a policy in 85% of runs. On RoboLab, the hardest family, it beats the multimodal Gemini-3.6-flash, which has the same index score (34). It wins without a library (23.1 against 18.3%) and with one (30.7 against 22.6% on the 58 tasks both completed), though not in best-of-3. DeepSeek-v4-flash trails Gemini-3.6-flash on LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO (by 12.1 and 6.0 points without a library). When SAM3 misses an object, DeepSeek-v4-flash has no fallback. Among the multimodal models, GPT-5.6-sol never opens images directly and Gemini-3.6-flash opens one in 2% of runs.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的猜测是操纵会奖励能看见的模型. 我们的结果不支持这个猜测。 DeepSeek-v4-flash是只使用文字的,然而它把工具箱中的工具结合到工作操控政策中去:它几乎所有的RoboLab政策都要求SAM3为取名对象提供口罩并使用深度图像来将口罩变成3-D位置,它在85%的跑道中产生了政策. 在最困难的家族RoboLab上,它击败了多模式双子座-3.6-flash,其指数得分相同(34分). 在没有图书馆的情况下获胜(23.1%对18.3%),在完成的58项任务中胜出(30.7%对22.6%),尽管在3项任务中成绩最好。 在LIBERO和LIBERO-PRO上深Seek-v4-flash出道双子座-3.6-flash(比12.1和6.0分没有库). 当 SAM3 错过对象时, DeepSeek-v4-flash 没有回落. 在多模式模型中,GPT-5.6-sol从不直接打开图像,双子座-3.6-flash在2%的跑道中打开一.

blocks.en: Images are used mainly for diagnosis. Opus views six to seven images per run. After viewing an image, it edits its code 38% of the time, against a 24% baseline, and Kimi-k3 edits after 68% of its views. The failures these models diagnose are physical, not perceptual. Over 21,552 graded RoboLab episodes, the target’s distance, rotation, and clutter barely predict success (correlation 0.04 in magnitude). What fails is the grasp. In episodes where the policy logged how wide the gripper was when it closed, the gripper had closed on air in 78% of failed episodes and in 18% of successful ones. Tasks that need 3-D relations, such as stacking, are among the easiest. Tasks that require grasping rims, handles, or thin shafts are the hardest. Few policies rely on a learned action model: only 2% of no-library RoboLab policies call the pretrained π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} in the toolbox. GPT-5.6-sol’s policies that used it scored 16%, against 54% for those that did not.
blocks.zh: 图像主要用于诊断. Opus每次查看六到七个图像. 在查看了一幅图像后,会以24%的基线来编辑其代码38%的时间,而Kimi-k3则会在其68%的浏览后进行编辑. 这些模型诊断的失败是物理的,不是认知的。 超过21,552个分级的RoboLab事件,目标距离,自转,和杂乱无章几乎无法预测成功(数量0. 失败的是把握。 政策记录了收尾时抓取器的宽度, 抓取器在78%的失败事件和18%的成功事件中关闭。 需要三维关系的任务,如堆放,属于最简单的任务. 需要抓取轮圈、手柄或细轴的任务最为困难。 很少有政策依赖于学习到的行动模式:只有2%的无图书馆机器人政策在工具箱中称预训了 \ 0.5\ 5}。 GPT-5.6-sol使用它的政策得分为16%,没有使用它的政策则得分为54%。

blocks.en: 5.3 Models Have Preferences
blocks.zh: 5.3 模式具有优先性

blocks.en: On hardware we also ran agent-as-policy: the LM stays in the loop at test time and re-observes the scene before every command ( Table 4 ). We gave two models the same instructions, which ask for one command at a time but allow the model to write its own tools. The two models act in opposite ways. GPT-6-astra issues every command through a separate model call and requests about one image per arm motion. Acting live, it scores 88.0%, against 41.4% as a frozen code policy, and 95% against 48% on the four non-stacking tasks. It uses a fresh image to notice and correct a mistake in at least 9 of its 25 evaluation episodes. Fable 5.1 instead scripts the robot: its tool code grows from 202 to 3,576 lines over the five tasks, those scripts issue 99% of its commands, and it looks at one image per seven motions. In effect, Fable 5.1 has turned live execution back into code-as-policy, and it scores about the same in both modes: 70% on the four non-stacking tasks either way. Overall it scores 66.4% live against 70.2% frozen, a gap that comes from Block Stacking, whose live runs used a different stopping rule. Each model scores highest in the mode it prefers, though for Fable 5.1 the margin is small. Acting live is slower: a live episode takes a median of 12.8 minutes of robot time against 3.8 for a frozen code policy ( Table 20 ). These comparisons rest on one practice run per model and five staged scenes per task.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Self-improving LM agents. An LM agent can improve without weight updates by writing reflections on its failures into memory, as in Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , by growing a library of code skills, as Voyager does in Minecraft ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , or by rewriting its own improvement procedure ( Zelikman et al., 2024 ) and harness ( Lin et al., 2026a ; Weng, 2026 ) . SEAR ’s library combines the first two. Lin et al. (2026b) show that much apparent self-evolution in LM agents is lucky resampling. Our best-of-3 and no-library controls test for the same effect in robot learning, where feedback comes from physical execution. Benchmarks for research agents ( Chan et al., 2024 ; Wijk et al., 2025 ; Starace et al., 2025 ; Rank et al., 2026 ) share our emphasis on fixed budgets and isolated grading, and our sealed judge adapts EdgeBench’s separate work and judge containers ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 自改进LM代理. LM剂可以在没有重量更新的情况下改进,如Reflexion(Shinn等,2023年)中写出其失真入内存的反思,如Voyager在Minecraft(Wang等,2023年)中所发展出代码技能库,或改写自己的改进程序(Zelikman等,2024年)和取用(Lin等,2026a;Weng等,2026年). SEAR的图书馆结合了前两个. Lin等 (2026b) 显示LM代理中许多明显的自演是幸运地再生. 我们的3和无图书馆控制测试在机器人学习中的相同效果,其中反馈来自物理执行. 研究代理人的基准(Chan等人,2024年;Wijk等人,2025年;Starace等人,2025年;Rank等人,2026年)与我们一样强调固定预算和孤立的分级,我们被封号的法官调整了Edge Bench的单独工作并审判容器(Zhu等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: LMs that write robot behavior. Code as Policies ( Liang et al., 2023 ) and ProgPrompt ( Singh et al., 2023 ) have an LM write executable robot programs from instructions; Eureka ( Ma et al., 2024 ) and RoboGen ( Wang et al., 2024 ) have it write the machinery that produces a policy, such as reward code or task scenes. Auto-research in SEAR belongs to the second line: the agent builds the data and training pipeline for a VLA ( Black et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 写机器人行为的LM。 代码为Policy (Liang et al., 2023)和ProgPrompt (Singh et al., 2023) 具有LM写出指令中可执行的机器人程序; Eureka (Ma et al., 2024)和RoboGen (Wang et al., 2024) 拥有它写出生成政策的机制,例如奖励代码或任务场景. SEAR中的自动研究属于第二行:代理为一VLA(Black等,2025年)构建数据和培训管道.

blocks.en: Self-evolving robot agents. CaP-X ( Fu et al., 2026 ) benchmarks and improves coding agents for manipulation; ASPIRE ( Lu et al., 2026 ) and RATs ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) grow skill libraries through practice or play and reuse them on new tasks; ENPIRE ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) lets an agent improve its own robot policy on real hardware; Waddle ( Waddle Labs, 2026 ) has agents control physical robots and share a skill library. A further wave appeared while this paper was being written. RPG ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , RoboRSI ( Wen et al., 2026 ) , and Embodied Turing Machines ( Hu et al., 2026b ) evolve a shared skill or code library through practice and validate changes before keeping them; Kuroki & Tang (2026) reuse an archive of agent-optimized programs on new tasks; Wei et al. (2026) evolve the harness of an agent that acts in the loop and find that keeping only revisions that beat the current harness matters. Closer to our auto-research mode, SimEX ( Hu et al., 2026a ) has a coding agent build and correct a robot toolbox and its simulator, and Robo-COP ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) lets an orchestrator fine-tune its VLA on demonstrations it curates on RoboLab tasks. Each defines its own protocol ( Table 1 ), so their results cannot be compared, and none reports both a budget-matched restart control (our best-of-3) and a no-library control. SEAR provides one shared protocol that includes both controls, and runs code-as-policy, agent-as-policy, and auto-research under it. Three findings elsewhere echo ours. An agent that decides after each tool call succeeds more often than a program written in advance (56 against 24%; Ge et al., 2026 ; see also Li et al., 2026 ; Si et al., 2026 ). An LM orchestrator that plans, checks outcomes, and recovers around frozen VLAs and skills lifts LIBERO-PRO success from 12.8 to 53.3% with no training, a gap its authors call the orchestration gap ( Galanti et al., 2026 ) . And 123 rounds of agentic skill discovery can fail to solve a single target task ( Wang, 2026 ) . Along the same lines, RoboHarness ( BinceQu, 2026 ) gives a coding agent tracked image keypoints and a few motion primitives, with no training, and reports beating VLA and world-action models on BEHAVIOR household tasks (at twice the challenge’s step budget) and lifting between 68 and 86 of 100 unseen objects, depending on the LM. LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) was itself built for lifelong learning. SEAR asks what a library is worth once the agent, rather than a training loop, decides what to keep. Interface standards such as XPolicyLab ( XPolicyLab, 2026 ) are complementary.
blocks.zh: 自演机器人特务. CaP-X(Fu等,2026年)基准并改进了被操纵的编码代理;ASPIRE(Lu等,2026年)和RATs(Zhang等,2026年a)通过练习或玩耍,在新任务上再利用它们来发展技能库;ENPIRE(Xiao等,2026年)让一个代理改进自己对真硬件的机器人政策;Waddle(Waddle Labs,2026年)有代理控制物理机器人并共享一个技能库. 本文撰写时又出现了一波. RPG(Wang等,2026年),RoboRSI(Wen等,2026年),和Embody Turing Machines(Hu等,2026年b)通过实践发展出共享技能或代码库并验证更改后再保留;Kuroki和Tang(2026年)在新任务上再使用一个代理优化程序档案;Wei等(2026年) 演化出一个在循环中行事的代理的利用,发现只保留修改以击败当前被操纵的事项. SimEX(Hu等,2026a等)在离我们自动研究模式更近的地方,拥有一个编码代理构建和校正机器人工具箱及其模拟器,而Robo-COP(Zhang等,2026b等)则让管弦乐手微调其在RoboLab任务上的演示的VLA. 每一个都定义了自己的协议(表1),因此其结果无法比较,没有报告一个预算匹配的重启控制(我们最好的3)和一个无图书馆控制. SEAR提供一种共享协议,既包括控制,又执行代码即取政策,代理即取政策,并在它下进行自动研究. 其他地方的三项发现与我们的一致。 在每次工具调用后决定成功的代理商比事先编写的程序要多(56对24%;Ge等人,2026;又见Li等人,2026;Si等人,2026.). 一名LM管弦乐手计划、检查结果并恢复了冰冻的VLA和技能,将LIBERO-PRO的成功率从12.8%提高到53.3%,没有经过培训,其作者称之为"管弦乐差距"(Galanti等,2026年)。 而123发的代理技能发现可能无法解决单一目标任务(Wang,2026. Robo Harness(BinceQu, 2026年)同样给出了追踪图像键和少数原始动作的编码代理, 但没有经过训练, LIBERO (Liu等, 2023) 本身是为终身学习而建. SEAR问,一旦代理商而不是训练圈决定保留什么,图书馆的价值是什么. XPolicyLab(XPolicyLab,2026年)等接口标准是相辅相成的.

blocks.en: Benchmarks of LM agents that use robots. RobotWorld ( Yang et al., 2026b ) evaluates frontier agents that act through robot tool calls on 84 simulated tasks across manipulation, locomotion, driving, and aerial control, one episode per task, and finds that models differ by the kind of goal they solve, as our models differ by how they prefer to act ( Section 5.3 ). RLE-Bench ( Ma et al., 2026 ) tests coding agents as robot learning engineers across control, policy learning, perception, and mechanical design. EmbodiedSWE ( Shen et al., 2026 ) benchmarks coding agents on long-horizon dexterous tasks and turns their verified solutions into VLA training data, noting that the solutions tend to be specialized to single task instances. These benchmarks measure what an agent can do in one attempt. SEAR measures what the agent keeps from practice and how far from practice that knowledge still works.
blocks.zh: 使用机器人的LM代理的基准. RobotWorld(Yang等,2026年b)评价通过机器人工具行事的前沿特工要求84个模拟任务,跨越操纵,运动,驾驶,以及空中控制,每个任务一次一集,并发现模型在他们解决的目标类型上有所不同,因为我们的模型在他们喜欢如何行事上有所不同(第5.3节). RLE-Bench(马等,2026年)测试编码剂作为机器人学习工程师跨越控制,政策学习,感知和机械设计. EmformSWE(Shen等,2026年)对长距离分解任务的基准编码剂,并将其已核实的解决方案转换为VLA培训数据,指出这些解决方案倾向于专门用于单个任务实例. 这些基准衡量代理人在一次尝试中能够做什么。 SEAR衡量代理人不实践的内容以及该知识是否仍然有效。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: A continual learning loop. Today a SEAR agent carries one thing from task to task: its library of code skills, tools, and written memories. A trained action model stays with the suite that produced it. The natural next step is a loop in which everything the agent touches improves together. Every round of practice produces rollouts and feedback, and that experience can flow into four places: the library, as reusable code and memories; the harness, meaning the sensors, tools, reset procedures, and safety limits the agent works through; the action model, fine-tuned on the agent’s own rollouts with failures filtered out or turned into recovery data; and eventually the LM itself, trained on its own interaction traces. Whatever improves is handed back to the agent for the next round. Seen this way, the persistent state of the whole system plays the role that weights play elsewhere, except that much of it is readable, editable knowledge. Our results point at one architecture for that loop: the LM as a deliberative layer that plans, diagnoses, and writes code, and a VLA as a reactive layer for continuous control, trained on what the LM delegates to it. Code policies break when the camera moves, but the VLA does not. The VLA, in turn, is limited by the demonstrations that code supplies ( Section 4.3 ). Each layer therefore covers the other’s failure. Figure 14 sketches the loop, and Appendix S describes what evaluating it would require. SEAR is built to test whether such a loop changes the shape of the improvement curve, not only its height.
blocks.zh: 一个不断学习的循环。 今天,一个SEAR代理人肩负着从任务到任务的一件事:它拥有代码技能,工具和书面记忆的库. 一个训练有素的行动模式 留在制作它的套房里 接下来的自然步骤是循环,物剂所接触的一切都会一起改善. 每轮练习都会产生展开和反馈,而这种经验可以流入四个地方:库,作为可再用代码和记忆;控制,意为传感器,工具,重置程序,以及安全性限制了代理工作;动作模型,对代理工作本身的展开进行微调,将故障过滤出或转化为恢复数据;最终LM本身,经过自身互动痕迹的培训. 任何改进都交给代理 下一轮。 由此可见,整个系统的持续状态在别处扮演了权重所扮演的角色,只是大部分是可读可编辑的知识. 我们的成果指向这个循环的一个架构:LM作为规划、诊断和写代码的议事层,以及VLA作为持续控制的反应层,对LM的代表进行了什么培训。 相机移动时代码政策会中断,但VLA没有. 反之,志愿军受到代号供应的示威(第4.3节)的限制。 因此,每一层都涵盖对方的失败。 图14勾画出环路,附录S说明了它需要进行什么评价。 SEAR是用来测试这种回路是否改变改进曲线的形状,而不仅仅是它的高度.

blocks.en: What the controls bought. Each finding depends on a control a single learning curve would not have. Without best-of-3, we could not tell when one long session beats three restarts. Without the no-library run, the library would seem to help every model. Without repeated runs, the run that collapsed after saving a false verdict ( Section 3.3 ) would read as a model difference. Without the sealed judge and its audit, the shortcuts of Section A.9 would count as skill. Without the tiers, a gain on held-out states would pass for transfer. Section A.7 turns these findings into design rules for anyone building such a system, and Section A.8 lists the limitations of this study.
blocks.zh: 控制器买的 每个发现都取决于一个控制 单一的学习曲线不会有。 没有最佳的3分,我们无法分辨何时一次长会比三次重新开始要好。 如果没有图书馆的运行,图书馆似乎会帮助每一个模型. 在不重复运行的情况下,在挽救错误判决(第3.3节)后倒闭的运行将被视为模式差异。 如果没有被封号的法官及其审计,A.9节的捷径将算作技能。 没有分级,被搁置状态的收益将转出。 A.7节将这些结论转化为任何建造这种系统的人的设计规则,而A.8节列出了这项研究的局限性。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: When an agent improves a robot from its own experience, a rising success rate is not enough evidence that it is learning. SEAR asks two questions: is the agent learning or just trying more often, and does what it learns help on tasks other than the one it practiced? It answers both with matched controls, a sealed judge, and five tiers of distance from practice. Across seven frontier LMs, the answers are mixed in ways a single learning curve would hide. Long sessions pay off only for models that are slow to reach a first success. Libraries help most for models that succeed sometimes but not reliably, and they can also hurt. Control code and shared routines transfer, while task-specific solutions do not, and a success streak in practice does not guarantee success on scenes someone else sets up. Finally, the choice of LM, and how that LM prefers to act, decide much of what the robot can do.
blocks.zh: 当一个特工从自身经验中改进一个机器人时,不断上升的成功率不足以证明它正在学习. SEAR提出了两个问题:代理学习还是只是更经常地尝试,除了它所练习的任务之外,它学到的什么帮助? 它既以相应的控制、密封法官以及距离实践的五级距离来回答。 7个边疆低地,答案混杂在一起,一个单一的学习曲线会隐藏。 长会只为缓慢取得第一次成功的模式带来收益。 图书馆对有时成功但不可靠的模型帮助最大,它们也会受到伤害. 控制代码和共享的常规传输,而针对特定任务的解决方案并不如此,而在实践中的成功记录并不能保证在别人设置的场景上的成功. 最后,LM的选择,以及该LM如何选择行动,决定了机器人可以做的很多事情.

blocks.en: We pool 1,510 matched model–task pairs across robosuite, LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboLab, each with three Vanilla repetitions and three Lineage repetitions (two on 171 pairs). Comparing means, Lineage scores higher than Vanilla on 96 of the 214 pairs where every Vanilla repetition scores zero. On the other 1,296 pairs it scores higher on 511 and lower on 354. Because a pair’s Vanilla score is itself noisy, some of these changes would appear in any rerun. We therefore compare each Lineage repetition with a third Vanilla repetition, both read against the mean of the first two Vanilla repetitions. On the 276 pairs where the first two Vanilla repetitions score zero, a Lineage repetition scores above zero in 32.5% of cases and at least 50% in 23.1%; the third Vanilla repetition does so in 22.5 and 13.0%. On the 1,234 pairs with some Vanilla success, a Lineage repetition scores above the Vanilla mean in 33.7% of cases and below it in 23.1%; the third Vanilla repetition, in 26.1 and 31.9%. The library therefore helps by 8 to 10 points on both kinds of pair. On unsolved pairs the margin comes from LIBERO-PRO and RoboLab; on LIBERO a third Vanilla repetition does as well. Bucketing pairs by the full Vanilla mean would be biased by regression to the mean, which is why the split-repetition comparison is used ( Table 7 ).

blocks.en: A.3 Library Crossover

blocks.en: We run GPT-5.6-sol on RoboLab with libraries written by Opus or Kimi-k3. For each task, the recipient gets the library version the donor held before attempting that task, with the same filters as in Lineage; the task, recipient model, and two-hour budget stay the same, and the crossover runs do not add their own experience to the donor library. One selected donor lineage per model, three runs of GPT-5.6-sol over all 105 tasks per donor, 630 runs in all; each task’s score averages its graded runs, leaving out seven judge crashes on policies that scored zero on validation. A useful library also reaches a higher score sooner. On the runs matched to the crossover (whose finals differ slightly from Table 15 ), GPT-5.6-sol with Opus’s library reaches 55.2% best-so-far validation success at half budget, above its no-library final 51.4%; For comparison, Kimi-k3 with its own library reaches 32.5% at half budget, above its Vanilla final 28.8%. In the crossover, the median time to first success among successful runs changes little; the library helps more runs succeed or reach higher scores within the budget.

blocks.en: Not every collapse is variance. (A self-exploration lineage starts from a donor library evolved on an earlier family; its frozen policy is the task-general program left at the end of exploration, and its authored policy the one rewritten once the instruction is disclosed.) The three Opus self-exploration replicates seeded from the LIBERO-RIG donor first read 26.7, 34.1, and 0.5% on RoboLab with the frozen policy, but the collapsed replicate was one of 23 lineages across four models that never discovered a wrong-axis gripper offset in the tool frame, a rig defect. Rerun from the start under the corrected frame, it finished at 25.0% frozen and 31.8% authored, close to but just below its two siblings, which had found the offset on their own. Its Gemini-3.6-flash counterparts did not recover: twelve rerun Gemini-3.6-flash lineages solved 11 of 1,429 graded tasks with the frame fixed. Only two self-exploration separations between models survive the replicate spread: Gemini-3.6-flash at or near zero on every RoboLab donor against an Opus mean of 24 to 37%, and Kimi-k3 ahead of Opus on LIBERO, 38.0 against 26.9% for the frozen policy.
blocks.zh: 并不是每个倒塌都不同 (自我探索世系始于一个在早期家庭上演化的捐赠图书馆;其被冻结的政策是勘探结束时留下的任务总程序,而其作者的政策是,一旦指示被披露,则重写。 ) 由LIBERO-RIG捐赠者出品的3个Opus自拓版自拓版先是用被冻结的政策在RoboLab上取出种子后读取了26.7,34.1和0.5%,但倒塌的复制是4个型号的23个线条之一,从未发现工具框中误用轴的抓取器相抵消,是钻机缺陷. 从头开始,在经过修正的框架下,它以25.0%的冻结和31.8%的作者完成,接近但仅低于其两个兄弟姐妹,他们自己找到了抵消。 其双子座-3.6-相克没有恢复:12个重跑双子座-3.6-相克相克线被固定了帧而解决了1,429个分级任务中的11个. 只有两种模型之间的自我探索分离在复制传播中幸存下来:双子座-3.6-在每一个机器人实验室捐赠者身上以零或接近零的速度对一个Opus的平均值为24至37%;而Kimi-k3在LIBERO上的Opus领先,冻结政策为38.0比26.9%.

blocks.en: A fix for one hardware fault does not carry to another. We take the policy each lineage wrote for a LIBERO-RIG course task and run it, frozen, on the same task under the other faults. It scores within − 10 -10 to + 10 +10 points of the policy the same model had written for that task on LIBERO-PRO, before it met any fault ( + 2 +2 for Opus, − 4 -4 for GPT-5.6-sol, − 10 -10 for Kimi-k3, + 10 +10 for DeepSeek-v4-flash, and + 3 +3 for Gemini-3.6-flash on validation at the moderate level; Appendix N ). Success also falls with severity (67, 60, and 52% on validation from the moderate to the most severe level), so a severe fault approaches the cost of a scene change; proprioception noise is the axis where code’s correction runs out (73, 37, and 4%; Table 12 ). The no-library control shows the same profile, so this pattern comes from code-as-policy with SAM3 perception, not from the learning loop. End-to-end VLA policies degrade instead of breaking: at the same moderate level, pooled over eight models, their success falls from 93 to 45% when the scene camera is moved and to 75% under a camera-to-arm calibration error ( Cui et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: What the two libraries keep. A code library holds executable control skills, 306 to 322 per RoboLab lineage, of which a final program imports a median of five. A VLA library holds the research process: collection and training scripts and a memory of what went wrong, with no checkpoints or data. That is enough to spare a lineage from rediscovering the label format: nine of twelve Vanilla sessions checked it by open-loop replay, against two of twelve Lineage sessions. Inheriting the research process pays only where the task is hard: a VLA lineage ties the no-library VLA on LIBERO (94.0 each), trails it on LIBERO-PRO (90.6 against 92.4), and leads it on RoboLab (47.2 against 43.1; Table 16 ), each from one run. Extra development time pays through data: on RoboLab, sessions that spent their second half collecting more data gained about four times as much as sessions that retrained on the same data ( Table 26 ); tasks that require two or more placements score about half as well as one-placement tasks, while instructions that require reasoning about attributes or counts cost nothing detectable ( Table 27 ). One session found that the harness’s velocity labels, differenced from teacher commands, replayed to 4.37 rad of arm travel where the teacher had produced 14.80, an error the training loss did not show.

blocks.en: A.7 Design Rules
blocks.zh: A.7 设计规则

blocks.en: Eight rules for anyone building a self-evolving robot agent, each from a finding of this study: 1. Qualify the base model on the hardest family first; a model below a minimum level of capability writes almost nothing worth saving, so its own library cannot help it ( Section 5.1 ). 2. Spend on grounded perception tools rather than on a multimodal model, and give image access for diagnosis ( Section 5.2 ). 3. Measure a model’s time to first success on a pilot and make sessions at least that long; beyond that, scale with parallel long runs. Report TEST, not VAL, scores ( Section 3.1 ). 4. Seed hard deployments with a library built around control and grasp routines, and test a library from another model if a model’s own does not help ( Sections 3.2 and 4.2 ). 5. Choose between code and weights by the kind of change you expect: code for faults the program can observe, and weights for camera motion and new instruction wording. When training weights, spend the budget on demonstrations first ( Section 4.3 ). 6. Never let a checker the agent wrote itself decide when practice stops unless an independent check confirms it, and record where each memory came from so it can be re-validated ( Section 3.3 ). 7. Set up the start state of each evaluation independently of the agent’s own resets, and do not end practice because of a success streak on scenes the agent reset itself ( Section 4.4 ). 8. Keep re-observation in the loop where things go wrong, and schedule re-tests of rules written after a single incident ( Sections 5.3 and 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 任何建立自我进取的机器人代理的八条规则, 每一个从本研究的发现: 1. 首先在最困难的家庭上对基本模型进行定性;低于最低能力水平的模型写作几乎没有什么值得保存的,所以它自己的图书馆无法帮助它(第5.1节. 2. 利用有根据的认知工具,而不是多模式模式,并给予图像诊断机会(第5.2节)。 3. 衡量一个模式在试点中首次取得成功的时间,并至少安排如此长的会议;除此之外,以平行长期的规模。 报告TEST,而不是VAL,分数(第3.1节)。 4. 使用一个围绕控制和把握日常的图书馆进行种子硬布置,如果模型本身无济于事,则从另一个模型测试一个图书馆(第3.2和4.2节)。 5. 选择代码和权重之间,按你期望的改变类型:程序可观察到的缺陷的代码,相机运动和新指令措辞的权重. 在培训加权时,预算首先用于示范(第4.3节)。 6. 绝不让代理人自己写的检查员决定何时停止练习,除非独立检查予以确认,并记录每个内存的来源,以便重新验证(第3.3节)。 7. 将每次评价的起步状态与代理商自己的重新定位分开,不因代理商重新设置的场景成功而结束实践(第4.4节)。 8. 继续重新观察事情发生错误的循环,安排对单一事件后编写的规则的重新测试(第5.3和4.4节)。

blocks.en: A.8 Limitations
blocks.zh: A.8 限制

blocks.en: Three runs per condition bound what we can distinguish, and replicate spread often exceeds the gap between neighboring models. The budget-matched VLA runs on LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboLab are one run each, and every physical result is one practice run per agent. Agent-as-policy uses five staged scenes per task, has no Opus run, and uses a different stopping rule for Block Stacking. The physical runs start from an empty library, so we measure learning on hardware, not transfer from simulation to hardware. Each model runs through its own coding tool, so a model comparison is a comparison of model-and-tool pairs. Budgets are matched in wall-clock time, not compute. The sealed judge protects runtime state, but it does not hide everything an agent can read ( Section A.9 ). A zero score in three runs does not show that a model can never solve a task, only that it did not within the budget. Finally, model rankings change when the agent is not given the task instruction: in self-exploration Kimi-k3 matches or beats Opus on five of seven settings ( Table 14 ).

blocks.en: A.9 Shortcuts the Agents Found
blocks.zh: A.9 找到代理的快捷键

blocks.en: The seal is not absolute ( Appendix C ), and agents found and used its openings without being asked, as reasoning models do when an evaluation leaves one ( Bondarenko et al., 2025 ) . The most common was reading static asset files: Opus parsed the object XML in 115 of 179 LIBERO runs and 552 of 1,015 LIBERO-PRO runs, and the scene USD in 1,533 of 1,743 RoboLab runs; Kimi-k3 read object XML in 284 of 1,260 non-RoboLab runs. This was allowed, and it helped, but a physical robot cannot read an object’s geometry before acting. Policies can also call the environment’s success check, env.check_success() , which we leave callable as a stop signal; it returns only whether the task is done, and the judge grades with its own copy. How often a policy stops or branches on it depends on the model: 47% of GPT-5.6-sol’s graded RoboLab policies against 5% of Opus’s.
blocks.zh: 封条不是绝对的(附录C),代理商发现并使用了它的开口而不被询问,当评价离开一个时推理模型就是这样做的(Bondarenko等,2025年). 最常见的是读取静态资产文件: Opus解析了179个LIBERO跑道中的115个和1 015个LIBERO-PRO跑道中的552个天体XML,1 743个RoboLab跑道中的1 533个场景为美元;Kimi-k3读取了1 260个非RoboLab跑道中的284个天体XML。 这样做是允许的,而且有帮助,但是一个物理机器人在行动前不能读取物体的几何. 政策也可以称为环境成功检查(env.check_success ()),我们把它留作停止信号;它只返回任务是否完成,以及法官的成绩和自己的副本。 政策常常会因模式而停止或中断:GPT-5.6-sol将RoboLab政策分级到5%的Opus。

blocks.en: Task text also leaks. LIBERO encodes each instruction in the task file’s name, its language block, and its goal predicate, so a sealed condition must strip all three. When we audited the libraries meant to seed our task-blind lineages, the post-LIBERO Opus library already quoted a hidden instruction word for word, in a memory recording “Turn on the stove”, and the post-LIBERO-PRO library matched 10 of 40 LIBERO and 27 of 160 LIBERO-PRO instructions, so we could not use it. The harness now refuses exploration sessions that touch held-out task identifiers and rewrites prompts that contain hidden material. In one pilot we dropped, we also tried to hide the success check: the patch covered only our wrapper, and Opus and GPT-5.6-sol found env.env.check_success() within a single session. A seal has to be tested by trying to break it, not by checking that the patch applied.
blocks.zh: 任务文本也泄露出. LIBERO将每个指令编码在任务文件的名称,语言块,以及目标上方,所以一个被封存的条件必须将所有三个都剥去. 当我们对图书馆进行审核时,我们打算培育我们的任务盲行,后LIBERO Opus图书馆在“炉子上转”的内存记录中,已经逐字引用了一个隐藏的指令词,LIBERO-PRO图书馆匹配了40个LIBERO中的10个和160个LIBERO-PRO指令中的27个,因此我们无法使用。 现在,这种牵引装置拒绝接触被搁置任务识别器的探索会话,并重写含有隐藏材料的提示. 在一个我们掉下来的飞行员中,我们也试图隐藏成功检查:补丁只覆盖了我们的包装,而Opus和GPT-5.6-sol在一个会话中发现了env.env.check_success(). 需要通过尝试打破来测试封条,而不是检查补丁是否应用.

blocks.en: Table 1 records what each system’s own paper or announcement reports; “partial” marks a feature that appears in a limited form. CaP-X ( Fu et al., 2026 ) : multi-turn program generation with execution feedback and an RL-trained coder (CaP-RL); simulation (robosuite, LIBERO-PRO, BEHAVIOR) and real robots; a task-agnostic skill library built from pooled rollouts and evaluated on the same tasks; a skill-library ablation without matched restarts; transfer to perturbations and from simulation to a real arm. ENPIRE ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) : the agent edits training code for learned policies (and can synthesize code policies) on a fleet of real bimanual stations, with simulation in Gym-PushT and RoboCasa; cross-task transfer appears through a written summary in one case; fixed test seeds and protected metrics in some settings, but agent-built verifiers. ASPIRE ( Lu et al., 2026 ) : code-as-policy with a growing skill library inherited by later tasks; an empty-library ablation but no budget-matched restarts; split debug, validation, and evaluation seeds with simulator ground-truth APIs forbidden; perturbations and unseen long-horizon tasks, with a limited real-robot study. RATs ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) : code-as-policy agents build a library through play and reuse it on downstream tasks; a no-play ablation and a compute-matched baseline but no independent restarts; held-out tasks, perturbations, a held-out simulator, and a preliminary real study. Waddle ( Waddle Labs, 2026 ) : agents control real arms by viewing cameras, writing code, and re-planning live, share a skill library, and in one case train an ACT policy; the announcement reports no controls or held-out evaluation. The rows of Table 11 come from each paper’s full text. Kuroki & Tang ( Kuroki & Tang, 2026 ) : a coding agent optimizes frozen programs for RoboCasa tasks and reuses an archive of four of them on nine new tasks; a no-archive comparison runs under shared session limits but unequal total compute; held-out test states, though the policies read ground-truth simulator segmentation. Harness evolution ( Wei et al., 2026 ) : an optimizer agent evolves the harness of a task agent that acts through a 3-D interface; selection-rule ablations but no restart or no-library control; held-out LIBERO tasks, while the RoboCasa campaign has no held-out set. SimEX ( Hu et al., 2026a ) : per-task programs over a persistent toolbox built within one task family; evaluation in a different simulator and on a real two-arm robot, after five scored adaptation rollouts in the evaluation environment. RPG ( Wang et al., 2026 ) : an offline coding model revises a shared skill library and system prompt that a runtime agent uses; held-out seeds, but improvement uses the same success check and privileged simulator state; its rounds are not budget-matched. Robo-COP ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) : an orchestrator writes per-episode programs that call a VLA and fine-tunes that VLA, per task; held-out initial states of the same tasks. Embodied Turing Machines ( Hu et al., 2026b ) : coding agents grow one shared library and frozen per-task programs on RoboDojo; held-out test layouts, with simulator ground truth used during development. RoboRSI ( Wen et al., 2026 ) : agents repair a shared skill hierarchy and compose it at run time; most results improve on the evaluation tasks themselves, and only LIBERO-Plus uses a frozen held-out evaluation.

blocks.en: The toolbox combines pretrained perception models with deterministic geometry and control. SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) provides text-prompted instance segmentation, returning masks, bounding boxes, and confidence scores. A vision-language model tool answers agent-defined questions about one or more images, optionally in a specified JSON format. It is instructed to describe visible properties (object identity, text, orientation, spatial relations) and to express uncertainty when observations are ambiguous. Its role is restricted to perception; task planning and action selection remain with the agent or generated policy. These perceptual estimates are separate from the external evaluator’s judgments.
blocks.zh: 工具箱结合了预受训练的知觉模型和确定几何和控制. SAM3(Carion等,2026年)提供文本速成实例分解,还原口罩,边框,和信心分数. 一个视觉语言的模型工具可以回答代理定义的关于一个或多个图像的问题,可选择使用指定的JSON格式. 它被指示描述可见属性(对象身份,文字,取向,空间关系),并在观测模棱两可时表达不确定性. 其作用仅限于感知;任务规划和行动选择仍由代理人或生成的政策承担。 这些概念性估计与外部评价者的判断是分开的。

blocks.en: Geometry tools map image observations into robot coordinates using calibrated projection, ray–plane intersection, and valid depth measurements. They support plane fitting, object localization, footprint and orientation estimation, and rectified top-down views. Per-camera metadata identifies whether depth is available and metrically valid. Geometry tools remain available throughout a run, while learned model tools are enabled according to the run configuration.
blocks.zh: 几何工具通过校正投影,射线-平面相接,以及有效的深度测量,将图像观测映入机器人坐标. 它们支持平面配置、物体本地化、足迹和定向估计,并纠正自上而下的观点。 每台相机元数据可以确定深度是否可用,且在参数上是否有效。 几何工具在整个运行期间仍然可用,而学习到的模型工具则根据运行配置启用.

blocks.en: Calibrated inverse-kinematics and servo interfaces support Cartesian motion, gripper control, and coordinated arm movement subject to workspace, joint-rate, and inter-arm separation constraints. Agents may query the motion planner without executing a command and replay recorded images to develop perception routines between physical attempts.
blocks.zh: 校正反相和servo接口支持笛卡尔运动,抓取控制,以及受工作空间,联合率,和武器间分离限制下的协调臂运动. 特工们可能会在不执行命令的情况下查询运动计划员,并重放被记录的图像,以在物理尝试之间发展感知常规.

blocks.en: Appendix H Physical Campaign Protocol

blocks.en: The physical campaign comprises five tasks and evaluates three coding agents, Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5 through Claude Code and GPT-6-astra through Codex, all at maximum reasoning effort, that revise executable policy bundles while keeping model weights fixed. Each lineage begins with an empty library, without a seed policy or simulation reference solution. Subsequent tasks inherit the preceding policy bundle and library. The library records reusable code, procedures, and textual memories together with their provenance. Code packages are harvested from successful executions supported by valid evidence, while procedures and memories may additionally retain lessons from failed attempts.
blocks.zh: 物理运动包括五项任务并评价了克洛德Fable 5.1和克洛德Opus 5通过克洛德代码,而GPT-6-astra则通过克洛德代码,它们都以最大的推理努力来修改可执行政策捆绑,同时保持模型权重的固定. 每一行从一个空库开始,没有种子政策或模拟参考解决方案. 随后的任务继承了前面的政策捆绑和库. 图书馆记录可重复使用的代码、程序和文字记忆及其出处。 密码包是从有有效证据支持的成功处决中获取的,而程序和记忆则可能从失败的尝试中进一步保留经验教训。

blocks.en: Each task receives a 12-hour wall-clock budget covering policy revision and physical interaction. Compared agents share the task order (Banana into Bowl, Push-T, Cup Upright, Block Stacking, Spell SEAR), hardware interfaces, available tools, and evaluator configuration, and run on a frozen harness package whose file set is checked by checksum on every rig; a lineage may move between rigs from one task to the next. A task may terminate early after ten consecutive scored forward-task successes. Early termination additionally requires successful evidence from both arms, and reset attempts, diagnostic probes, and outcomes marked unknown or invalid are excluded from the early-stopping window. Block Stacking has no early stop: the tower persists between attempts, an attempt succeeds when the free-standing column ends taller than it started, and toppling the tower is a separate reset task.
blocks.zh: 每项任务都得到12小时一时的预算,包括政策修订和实际互动。 比较代理共享任务顺序(Banana into Bowl, Push-T, Cup Upright, Block Stacking, Spell SEAR),硬件接口,可用工具,以及评估器配置,运行在被冻结的被子套件上,其文件集通过每个钻机的校验和来检查;从一个被子套件到下一个被子套件之间的线条可能会移动. 一项任务在连续10次取得前置任务成功后可能会提前终止。 早期终止还需要双臂的成功证据,重新设定尝试、诊断探测器和标有未知或无效的结果被排除在早期停止窗口之外。 Block Stacking没有早期的停站:塔在尝试之间坚持到底,当独立的柱子结束比开始的高时,尝试成功,而推倒塔台则是单独的重置任务.

Other objects must remain undisturbed; incidental bowl displacement of up to approximately one bowl radius is permitted. • Push-T. The green 3D-printed block has a 200 × 200 200\times 200 mm footprint and a height of 40 mm.
