blocks.en: This appendix details the audit summarized in Section 4.4 . For every failed or partial evaluation unit we located, in the evaluation record and the frozen policy, the check that ended progress, and classified it by what stopped the robot: a physical impossibility; a refusal by the harness, namely its safety guard, motion planner, joint limits, or step budget; or a limit the agent wrote itself, such as a reach cap, tolerance, clearance margin, grasp restriction, disabled step, or stopping rule. A scene counts as physically possible when another agent, the same agent in the other mode, or the platform’s measured grasp reach shows that the motion can be done. The harness enforces joint limits, a workspace box per arm, a 0.25 m keep-out region around the other arm’s base, and a speed limit near the table. It does not model objects on the table, and its planner checks straight-line paths locally, so a refusal does not establish that a target is unreachable. Table 21 gives the counts. The units comprise Fable’s and Opus’s frozen-policy episodes, block-placement calls from GPT-6-astra’s frozen Block Stacking policy and its other frozen-policy episodes, and Fable’s live AaP episodes. Because block-placement calls and whole-task episodes are different units, the counts describe the audited failures rather than a common episode-level failure rate across models. Camera images were not part of this audit; statements about contact between objects rest on logged motion and stopping heights.
blocks.zh: 本附录详述第4.4节概述的审计。 对于我们发现的每一个失败或部分评估单位, 在评价记录和被冻结的政策中, 结束了进展的检查, 并按阻止机器人的方式分类: 物理上不可能; 吊带的拒绝, 即它的保安, 运动计划员, 联合限制, 或步骤预算; 或限制 代理人自己写的, 如达到上限, 容忍度, 清除幅度, 抓取限制, 禁用步骤, 或停止规则。 一个场景在物理上尽可能的计算,当另一个代理,同一代理在另一个模式中,或者平台所测量到的抓取能力显示运动是可以完成的. 牵引装置执行联合限制,每只手臂有一个工作空间箱,另一只手臂的基座周围有一个0.25米外出的区域,桌子附近有一个速度限制。 它不模拟桌上的物体,它的策划者在当地检查直线路径,所以拒绝并不能确定一个目标是无法到达的. 表21列出数字。 这些单位包括Fable和Opus的被冻结的政策事件、GPT-6-astra的被冻结的块堆放政策和其他被冻结的政策事件以及Fable的AaP直播事件。 由于区块定位呼叫和全任务集是不同的单位,计数描述的是被审计的失败,而不是跨模型的常见的分集级失败率. 相机图像不是这项审计的一部分;关于物体之间接触的叙述依赖于记录的运动和停止高度。

blocks.en: Further audited cases ( Section 4.4 ). In Fable’s Spell SEAR run, a letter-straightening step turned a letter the wrong way on its only practice use; the agent disabled the step after that single attempt and left it disabled, and the frozen policy leaves a crooked letter in two evaluation scenes. Its code for clearing the middle of the table runs in 6 of 10 evaluation scenes but never ran during practice. Opus’s Block Stacking policy measured cubes at 37–39 mm but in its ninth hour fixed the size at 28–33 mm to match the judge’s nominal value, and it interprets normal arm tracking error as contact, raising release heights by 8–19 mm; only 1 of 11 cubes placed on a column remains there in the last six evaluation episodes, against 7 of 15 in the first four. GPT-6-astra’s Cup Upright policy lays the cup back down and stops after a refused turn with about two thirds of its steps unused, and Opus’s Push-T policy stops 80 to 170 ∘ 170^{\circ} from the goal with 8,000 to 11,000 of its 15,000 steps left. Most stops not attributable to the policy’s own rules were harness refusals of poses those policies selected.
blocks.zh: 进一步审计的案件(第4.4节)。 在Fable的"Spell SEAR跑"中,一个紧靠字母的步子在它唯一的练习用法上使一个字母变了错误;代理在单次尝试后就禁用了步子,而被冻结的政策在两个评价场景中留下了一条曲折的字母. 其清理表格中间的代码在10个评价场景中运行了6个,但在练习期间从未运行. 奥普斯的"块堆放"政策测出立方体为37-39毫米,但在第九小时时将尺寸固定为28-33毫米以与法官的名义值相匹配,它将正常的手臂跟踪误差解释为接触,将放出高度提升了8-19毫米;在前6个评价事件中,放入一列的11个立方体中只有1个仍保留在那里,而前4个事件为15个中的7个. GPT-6-astra的Cup Upright政策让杯子倒下并停了下来, 与政策本身的规则无关的多数措施是利用所选择的政策的拒绝。

blocks.en: Table 21: What stopped each failed or partial evaluation unit. A unit is an episode, except for GPT-6-astra’s Block Stacking, where each block-placement call counts. Harness refusal : all three of Fable’s arise from poses its own code selected when a working alternative existed; Opus’s are one refusal it steered into and two grasps that missed on the left arm’s provisional calibration; most of GPT-6-astra’s refuse paths its own rules chose, and 42 of its 47 units trace to its own choices.
blocks.zh: 表21:每个失败或部分评价单位的终止原因。 一个单元是一个插曲,除了GPT-6-astra的"块堆放"(Block Stacking),每个块-位置调用都算数. 合理性拒绝:Fable的这三条规则都是在工作替代方案存在时由自己选择的;Opus的拒绝是它所引导的一次拒绝,以及左臂暂时校正上错失的两道接力;GPT-6-astra的拒绝路径大多是它自己选择的规则,47个单元中有42个追踪到自己的选择。

blocks.en: Banana into Bowl. No frozen failure dropped a banana, set it beside the bowl, or knocked the bowl; every full failure is a move refused or abandoned, and each policy tries its first plan once. Fable grasps with the gripper tilted by at most 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} , so a banana 0.60 m out was refused although tilted grasps reach it. GPT-6-astra quits when both of its two camera poses are unavailable, having removed an earlier fallback within minutes of its first launch without any incident, and lifts or carries with a single wrist angle. In one scene the banana and bowl are 0.76 m apart and each arm reaches only one of them. No frozen policy passes the banana between arms; both live agents did, though with more motion steps than the frozen budget allows. Opus releases over the bowl center, 30 mm above the rim, wherever it holds the banana. It wrote this rule before its first robot attempt, and two bananas came to rest across the rim.
blocks.zh: 香蕉进碗. 没有被冻结的失败会掉下香蕉,放在碗边,或者敲出碗来;每一次完全失败都是拒绝或放弃的举动,每一次政策都会尝试第一个计划. 所以一个0.60米外的香蕉 被拒绝了 虽然倾斜的抓取到达了 GPT-6-astra在两个相机相机相机均不可用时退出,在首次发射后几分钟内移除了更早的回落而未发生任何事故,并举起或携带了单一腕角. 在一个场景中,香蕉和碗相隔0.76米,每只手臂只伸到其中一个. 任何被冻结的政策都不能在武器之间传递出香蕉;这两个活体特工都这样做了,尽管采取的行动步骤比被冻结的预算允许的要多。 Opus在碗状中心上空释放出,在边缘上方30毫米,无论它持有香蕉的地方. 它在第一次机器人尝试之前就写了这个规则,有两根香蕉来过圆圈休息.

blocks.en: Push-T. The staged scenes often require a large turn. Fable pushes up to 10.5 cm, turning the block 13 to 37 ∘ 37^{\circ} per push, and re-measures after every push. Opus shortened its pushes to 35 mm in its fourth hour, after pushes appeared to spin the block by 65 to 171 ∘ 171^{\circ} at a time when its model of the tool–block contact was wrong and some headings were misread. It corrected the model at hour 7.5 but never revisited the push length. Its left-arm pushes delivered a median 8% of the predicted turn against 64% for the right arm, and its two stopping rules, written for the final centimetres, fired 80 to 170 ∘ 170^{\circ} from the goal. The 16 ∘ 16^{\circ} cap on predicted turn per push in its code was never reached, because a 35 mm push cannot be predicted to turn the block by more than about 14 ∘ 14^{\circ} . GPT-6-astra rejected correct outline fits scoring 7.8 and 8.6 mm against a fixed 7 mm limit, unchanged since its first hour, and ended both attempts without touching the block. Elsewhere its finishing tolerance, tighter than the judge usually applies, sent it into extra pushes that worsened the pose, and each of its pushes costs about 835 motion steps because it lifts to a camera pose after every push.
blocks.zh: 推-T (英语). 所上演的场景往往需要大转弯. 寓言推高至10.5厘米,将13号区块改为37 QQ 37 Circ}每推后,再取回再取回再取回. Opus在第四小时将其推力缩短为35毫米, 之后推力似乎在65至171 QQ 171 Circ} 时, 它在7.5小时修正了模型,但从未重新审视过推力长度. 它的左臂推力为右臂64%的预想转弯提供了中位数8%,它的两道截取规则(为最后一厘米所写)从入球射出80到170分(170分). 因为35毫米的推力无法预测会让路由超过14分14分左右。 GPT-6-astra拒绝正确的轮廓符合7.8和8.6毫米的分数,与固定的7毫米限制相对应,自第一个小时起保持不变,并结束了两次尝试而未触碰该块. 在其他地方,它的完成耐受性比法官通常更严格,它送入了额外的推力,使姿势恶化,每次推力都花费了大约835个动作步骤,因为每次推力后它都会升入相机姿势.

blocks.en: Cup Upright. Fable’s only method pinches the rim through the cup’s opening, which works only when the opening faces an arm. It chose the method in its first 20 minutes, following a suggestion in the task card, and never tried the body grasp that both other agents used on the same scenes. All three of its frozen failures are refusals with no motion, and one was caused by a 0.20 m clearance from the parked arm, inherited from Push-T and never tested, where the harness requires 0.12 m. Opus’s near-horizontal body grip left the cup upright in 2 of 9 stand-ups, with no check that the grip holds. GPT-6-astra grips the body and turns the cup in the air. With the cup held 0.40–0.435 m from the arm base, 17 of 18 practice turns succeeded; at 0.454 m or more, all 5 were refused at the wrist. Its rule for choosing where to turn was revised twice, each time to fix the latest incident, and in one evaluation scene it picked the farther spot. After any refused turn it lays the cup down and stops. Its live agent instead turned the cup flat on the table and re-gripped it.
blocks.zh: 足协杯 Fable的唯一方法是将圆圈挤入杯口, 它在最初的20分钟中根据任务卡中的一则建议选择了这个方法,并且从未尝试过身体抓住其他两个特工在同一场景中使用的方法. 其被冻结的三起故障均是拒绝而无动静,一起是由停放的臂上0.20米的通关所造成,继承自Push-T并从未被测试过,而吊带需要0.12米. Opus的近乎横向的身体握住,在9个站立的2个站立处将杯子直立,没有检查握住。 GPT-6-astra握住身体后将杯子转入空中. 杯子从手臂基座取出0.40–0.435米后,18个练习中17个成功;在0.454米或以上时,全部5个在手腕被拒绝. 其选择转弯地点的规则经过了两次修改,每次都是为了解决最近的事故,在一个评价场景中它选择了更远的地方. 在任何拒绝转弯之后,它会把杯子放下并停下来。 它的活生生的特工却把桌上的杯子翻了个平并重新抹去.

blocks.en: Block Stacking. Fable places cubes within a median 2.9 mm, and the error does not grow with height. Its stall at about nine cubes looks like a wrist limit, but follows from its own choice to square each cube with the one below: from layer seven it turned the gripper 28 to 41 ∘ 41^{\circ} off the line from the arm base, and at that height the planner accepted 17 of 17 moves with the gripper within 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} of the line and 4 of 34 when it was 30 to 43 ∘ 43^{\circ} off. In practice it rarely built above six cubes after its record in hour three. Opus’s placement code carried a height correction between calls that counted the arm’s normal 3 mm tracking error as contact. The correction grew to 17–20 mm; cubes that stayed were released a median 0.2 mm below the true top and cubes that fell a median 6.5 mm above it, and the cube size it had fixed at 28–33 mm plausibly added to the error. When GPT-6-astra released a cube, it almost always stayed, 6 of 7 times, but most calls stopped before releasing. A low carrying path that keeps 170 mm from the tower and about 92 mm from every other cube, whatever that cube’s height, blocked 8 calls, and replaying its planner with a height rule it wrote later finds a path in 7 of them. A 6.1 ∘ 6.1^{\circ} heading tolerance, 200-step descent allowances, and a camera-coverage threshold ended 8 more, and harness reach refusals on approaches it had chosen ended 3. It spent 5.7 of its 12 hours on a narrow-grasp method for crowded cubes, which produced one practice success, and never considered moving cubes apart.
blocks.zh: 块堆叠. 有线将立方体置于中位数2.9毫米以内,误差不会随高度而增大. 它在大约9个立方体的摊位看起来像一个腕部限制,但从它自己选择的每个立方体与下面一个相平:从第7层开始,它把抓手从手臂基线上移出第28至41分之41分之41分之4分之一;在这一高度上,规划者接受了17个动作中的17个,在行中10分之10分之4分之43分之43分之四。 实际上,它很少在创记录的第三小时之后建造超过6个立方体。 Opus的定位代码在将手臂正常的3毫米跟踪误差算作接触的通话之间进行了高度校正. 校正已增长至17-20毫米;所停留的立方体被放出正上方下方为中值0.2毫米的立方体并倒入正上方为中值6.5毫米的立方体,而已固定为28-33毫米的立方体大小则明显地增加了出错. 当GPT-6-astra释放出一个立方体时,它几乎总是停留了下来,是7次中的6次,但大多数电话在释放前都停止了. 低载行道从塔上保持了170毫米的距离,从其他每个立方体上保持了约92毫米的距离,不管立方体的高度如何,它屏蔽了8个呼叫,并用它后来所写的高度规则重放其规划者,在其中7个中发现了一条路径. 6.1 = 6.1 = Circ = 标题容忍度、200步后卫津贴和相机覆盖阈值又结束了8个,对它所选择的3个方法的拒绝也得到了利用。 它用了12个小时中的5.7个小时,对拥挤的立方体采用狭长的花纹法,这产生了一种练习成功,并且从未考虑将立方体分开.

blocks.en: Spell SEAR. No frozen policy put a wrong letter in the row. Staged scenes 6 to 10 add a crowded middle, letters lying across the target row, and required letters 0.53–0.58 m from the nearer arm base, and no frozen policy solved scenes 6 to 9. Besides the crooked and distant letters described in Section 4.4 , Fable twice lowered a letter that, judging from its logged stopping height, came to rest on a required letter still standing near its slot, because its clearing code removes only unneeded blocks. GPT-6-astra’s frozen policy refuses any placement whose fully open hand, modeled as an 86 × 144 86\times 144 mm rectangle, would touch another block. The rectangle only grew during practice, its notes explicitly refuse to shrink it, and it caused 13 refusals, while its step budget ran out in 5 of 10 scenes. Its live agent reordered letters, cleared distractors, and tilted the tool for distant letters, and succeeded on every staged scene it was given. Every evaluation scene requested SEAR, so reading direction was not tested in evaluation.
blocks.zh: 拼写搜索。 没有冻结政策把错误的字母放在一行。 舞台剧场景6到10会增加一个拥挤的中间,信倒在目标行对面,需要从更近的臂基站出0.53–0.58米的字母,没有被冻结的政策解决了场景6到9. 除了第4.4节所描述的曲折而遥远的字母外,Fable两次降低了一个字母的下限,从记录的停止高度来看,这个字母停留在仍然站在槽口附近的一个必要的字母上,因为其清除码只去除了不需要的块. GPT-6-astra的冻结政策拒绝任何完全开放的手, 矩形只在实践期间才有增长,其笔记明确拒绝收缩,并导致13次拒绝,而其步入预算则在10个场景的5个场景中耗尽. 其活生生的代理重排了信件的顺序,清除了分心器,并倾斜了用于远方信件的工具,并在所给出的每一个舞台上都成功. 每个评价场景都要求SEAR,因此阅读方向没有在评价中测试.

blocks.en: Earlier work is not carried forward. Fable’s counted Spell SEAR segment starts from its Block Stacking workspace. An earlier launch of the same task, not the one counted, had already picked distant letters with a tilted gripper and re-checked each letter’s angle after placing it, but inheritance follows the task order, so the counted segment never saw that work. More generally, only 1 to 25% of a bundle’s substantive code lines recur in the same agent’s bundle for the previous task. The exception is Block Stacking to Spell SEAR, where Fable keeps about 40% and GPT-6-astra about 47% by reusing their cube-handling code for letter blocks, while Opus keeps 3 to 6%. No frozen policy reads the persistent library.
blocks.zh: 早先的工作没有继续进行。 Fable的Spell SEAR段从块堆叠工作区开始计算。 早先推出同一任务,而不是计算在内,已经选取了带有倾斜式抓取器的远方字母,并在放入后重新检查了每个字母的角度,但继承遵循了任务顺序,因此计数部分从未看到过这项工作. 更一般地说,只有1到25 % 的捆绑实质性代码线会在同一代理商的捆绑中重复用于前一个任务。 例外的是Block Stacking to Spell SEAR,其中Fable通过重用字母块的立方体处理代码保存了约40%和GPT-6-astra保存了约47%,而Opus则保存了从3%到6%. 没有冻结政策读取持久图书馆。

blocks.en: How the sessions are spent. Across the five tasks, GPT-6-astra made 8,023 tool calls, about 133 per hour, against 2,660 for Fable and 3,528 for Opus, and it read harness documentation and source 911 times, against 185 and 163. After changing code, Fable ran an offline check before the next hardware attempt in 62% of cases, GPT-6-astra in 47%, and Opus in 30%; after a failure, Fable opened an additional camera image before retrying in 44% of cases, against 7% for Opus. Opus never ran the Block Stacking reset task and cleared the spelled word once in 12 hours, whereas Fable ran a scored reverse attempt after almost every forward attempt. For every agent the robot was executing an attempt for only 34–42% of session time.
blocks.zh: 如何用会. 在5个任务中,GPT-6-astra打了8 023个工具电话,大约每小时133个,而Fable是2 660个,Opus是3 528个,它读取了取回文件和911源,185和163个。 在更改了代码后,Fable在下一次硬件尝试之前对62%的病例进行了离线检查,GPT-6-astra为47%,Opus为30%;失败后,Fable在44%的病例中重新试镜前打开了额外的相机图像,而Opus为7%. Opus从未运行过"块堆叠"重置任务,并在12小时内清理了拼出单词一次,而Fable在几乎每一次前行尝试后都运行了一次得分倒置尝试. 对于每个特工来说,机器人只用了34-42%的会话时间进行尝试。

blocks.en: Appendix L Physical Campaign: Practice Behavior in Detail
blocks.zh: 附录L 运动:详细实践行为

blocks.en: This section expands Section 4.4 .
blocks.zh: 本节扩充了第4.4节.

blocks.en: Figure 18: Every physical practice attempt against time. Every forward attempt of the physical CaP campaign against hours since the task’s launch: tall ticks are scored attempts (green success, red failure), short grey ticks unscored attempts, and the black bar the tenth consecutive scored success, where the run stops; Block Stacking has no early stop. The right margin gives each task’s held-out score out of ten.
blocks.zh: 图18:每次物理练习尝试与时间相对. 自任务启动以来, CaP 运动的每次前行尝试都以小时计数:高的滴滴是得分尝试(绿色成功,红色失败),短的灰色滴滴滴没有得分的尝试,而黑条则是连续第10个得分成功,跑道停止了; Block Stacking没有提前停止。 正确的比值是每个任务被搁置得分的10分。

blocks.en: Fable reaches the ten-success streak on all four non-stacking tasks, using 29.5 hours of hardware time across the five tasks; Opus reaches it on two, and GPT-6-astra on none in 60 hours ( Table 18 ). segments that reached the streak average 67% on staged scenes, against 38% for the six non-stacking segments that ran out of budget. Figure 18 shows every practice attempt.
blocks.zh: Fable在所有四项非堆放任务上都达到了十胜一负,在五个任务中使用了29.5小时的硬件时间;Opus在两个任务上到达,GPT-6-astra在60小时内没有达到(表18)。 在舞台剧中平均达到67%的片段,而预算用完的6个非片段则为38%。 图18显示了每一项实践尝试。

blocks.en: Probes and scene variation. GPT-6-astra spends 358 of its 597 attempts, 60%, on unscored probes, compared with 8 of 355 for Fable. Opus uses 72 probes in total, 51 of them on Spell SEAR. On that task, GPT-6-astra spends five hours practicing pick and place through the clearing task before attempting the Spell SEAR task; its last seven scored spellings then succeed, three short of the streak. Many of GPT-6-astra’s probes deliberately change the next starting state: with its jaws closed it pushes the empty bowl 20–40 mm to a new position; it sets up a T rotated by 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} ; and it performs 48 of its 52 cup resets as probes to place cups farther out. These actions follow an instruction to succeed across layouts. At least three of its success streaks break on the scored attempt following such a probe.
blocks.zh: 探测和场景变异 GPT-6-astra在它的597个尝试中花出358个,60%用于无分数的探测器,而"有线"的355个尝试中有8个. Opus总共使用了72个探测器,其中51个在Spell SEAR上. 在完成这项任务时,GPT-6-astra在尝试Spell SEAR任务之前花费了五个小时练习取出并放置清空任务;其最后七个得分的拼写随后成功,相差三分. 许多GPT-6-astra的探测器有意地改变下一个起始状态:由于它的下巴被关闭,它将空碗20-40毫米推向了一个新的位置;它设置了由180 QQ 180 QCirc}旋转的T;它作为探测器完成了其52个杯子中的48个来放置更远的杯子. 这些行动遵循指示,在各种布局上取得成功。 至少有三次成功 都发生在这次探险之后

blocks.en: Reset states versus staged states. In every one of Fable’s practice spellings, its scrambling reset leaves at most one block in the middle of the table and no required letter farther than 0.48 m from an arm base; in evaluation, 8 of 10 scenes have blocks in the middle and 2 have a required letter 0.53–0.58 m away. Only 10 of Opus’s 64 practice Push-T starts require a turn of more than 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} , compared with 6 of the 10 staged scenes. GPT-6-astra’s reset always leaves the T within 175 mm of its outline, whereas the staged starts are 158–269 mm away. Fable’s cup reset leaves every cup with its opening toward an arm. In Fable’s Cup Upright run a dropped cup came to rest facing away from both arms; the agent continued without resolving that configuration, 14 refused resets did not count toward the streak, and it reached the streak with 7.7 of its 12 hours unused.
blocks.zh: 重设州与分级州. 在Fable的每个练习拼写中,它的摇摆倒置的叶子最多位于桌子中间的一个街区上,没有超过0.48米的必需字母;在评价中,10个场景中有8个在中间有块,2个在0.53至0.58米外有必需字母. Opus的64个练习中只有10个Push-T开始需要90个以上的转弯,而10个舞台上的场景中有6个。 GPT-6-astra的重置总是让T在它的轮廓的175毫米以内,而相接的起步距离为158-269毫米. Fable的杯子重置后, 在Fable's Cup Upright的比赛中,一个倒下杯子在两只手臂相向而行;代理商继续没有解决这一配置问题,14个拒绝的重装机没有算在跑道上,在12个小时的未用时间中达到7.7个。

blocks.en: Live execution. Under agent-as-policy, Fable’s code grows from 202 lines after Banana into Bowl to 3,576 lines in 30 files after Spell SEAR, with at least 15 files issuing robot commands; these scripts account for 99% of its 33,532 practice commands and 98% of its 5,916 evaluation commands, and on Block Stacking and Spell SEAR background loops open and close most practice attempts without a separate model decision. GPT-6-astra issues each of its 7,537 commands through a separate model call, requests about one image per arm motion against Fable’s 0.14, and writes ten small helpers, none of which moves the robot. Fable’s scripted Cup Upright routine closes on the cup’s paper wall in all 18 visible practice grasps and in none of 23 evaluation grasps; its single evaluation success comes after switching to a body-squeeze routine written during practice.
blocks.zh: 活活处决. 根据代理政策,Fable的代码从香蕉入碗后202行增长到Spell SEAR后30个文件中的3,576行,其中至少15个文件发布机器人命令;这些脚本占其33,532个练习命令的99%,占其5,916个评价命令的98%,在Block Stacking和Spell SEAR背景循环上打开并关闭了大多数没有单独模型决定的练习尝试. GPT-6-astra通过单独的模型调用发布其7,537个命令,要求每个手臂运动一个图像来对抗Fable的0.14,并写出十个小助手,其中没有一个能移动机器人. Fable的脚本Cup Upright 常规关闭了该杯的纸墙,在所有18个可见的练习中,没有任何一个在23个评价中;它的单一评价成功是在切换到练习时写出的身体挤压常规后完成的。

blocks.en: Cost. GPT-6-astra issues its first robot attempt 3 to 8 minutes after each launch, while Fable and Opus first spend 23 to 53 minutes reading and writing code. Per scored forward success, practice costs about $3.7 in API spend for Fable, $11 for Opus, and $18 for GPT-6-astra. For the Cup Upright segment the recorded API costs are about $96, $254, and $368, respectively.
blocks.zh: Cost. GPT-6-astra在每次发射后3至8分钟发布其第一次机器人尝试,而Fable和Opus首先花费了23至53分钟读取并写作代码. 每个得分成功者,实践费用约为3.7美元,API用于Fable,11美元用于Opus,18美元用于GPT-6-astra. 对于Cup Upright部分,记录的API成本分别为96美元,254美元和368美元.

blocks.en: Losing objects. Opus’s Spell SEAR policy knocks the S off the table in the fourth hour, the E in the sixth, and the R in the ninth. From hour 4.4 its own scene description reports that the word cannot be completed because the S is missing. Nevertheless it spends its last 7.5 hours, and 62 of its 101 attempts, continuing the task; its memory records the loss of the S and E, but further code revision cannot replace the missing letters. Practice ends with 1 success in 45 scored spelling attempts, and the frozen policy scores 0 of 10 on the staged scenes. In the third hour of Opus’s Cup Upright run an attempt knocks a lying cup off the table; the next 169 attempts, including the ten-success streak, operate on the remaining two-cup scene.
blocks.zh: 失所取物. Opus的Spell SEAR政策在第四小时将S击倒,在第六小时将E击倒,在第九小时将R击倒. 从4.4小时起,它自己的场景描述报告,由于"S"缺失,这个词无法完成. 尽管如此,它还是用了最后的7.5小时,101次尝试中的62次,继续了任务;它的内存记录了S和E的丢失,但进一步的代码修订无法取代缺失的字母. 实践以45分的拼写尝试中1分成功而告终,被冻结的政策在舞台上评分为0分10分. Opus Cup Upright的第三个小时里,有人试图把一个躺着的杯子从桌子上敲倒;接下来的169次尝试,包括十胜一负的冲刺,在剩下的两杯场景上运作.

blocks.en: Block Stacking. The task asks for the tallest tower, and the run’s score is the maximum height reached, but the feedback for each placement is a binary success whenever the column ends taller than it started. Fable reaches 310 mm, about eight cubes, in its third hour, then cycles through building towers of five or six cubes, toppling them, and rebuilding ( Figure 20 ). Placements that increase the height of these shorter towers continue to earn successful verdicts even though the record does not improve. Placement success and progress toward a higher tower must therefore be reported separately; the pattern does not by itself establish that the feedback caused the rebuilding.
blocks.zh: 块堆叠. 任务要求最高的塔,跑步的分数是所达到的最大高度,但每次布置的回馈都是一二进制成功,只要柱子结束比开始高. 有线电视在第三小时达到310毫米,大约为8个立方体,然后通过5至6个立方体的建造塔进行循环,将其推倒并重建(图20)。 提高这些更短塔高高地的位置继续得到成功的判断,尽管记录没有改善. 因此,必须单独报告在建高塔方面取得的成功和进展;这种模式本身并不能证明反馈导致重建。

blocks.en: This section summarizes the design of LIBERO-RIG ( Cui et al., 2026 ) , the benchmark that supplies the hardware-fault condition of tier T2 ( Section 2.4 ) and one of the five simulated families. The companion paper also evaluates nine end-to-end VLA models under the same protocol, which we do not reproduce here.
blocks.zh: 本节总结了LIBERO-RIG(Cui等,2026年)的设计,该基准供应了T2级(2.4节)的硬件故障条件,以及五个模拟家庭之一. 配套论文还评价了同协议下9个端到端的VLA模型,我们在此不转载.

blocks.en: LIBERO-RIG measures how robust a policy is to perturbations of the physical parameters of the robot it runs on, with the task held fixed. It keeps the instruction, the object identities, the success predicate, and the nominal initial-state identifiers of every LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) task, and changes only the rig, the robot hardware and the way it is set up, one axis at a time, by a prescribed amount. The rig is parameterized by the extrinsics and intrinsics of the scene and wrist cameras, the calibration between camera and arm, the gain and rate of the controller, the noise in the arm’s reported state, the base pose of the arm, the table height, and the geometry of the end-effector pads. Formally, the rig configuration enters the episode in three places: the sensing map, through which the policy observes the world (camera mounting and optics, proprioception noise); the actuation map, through which its commands reach the world (camera-to-arm calibration, gain); and the physical arrangement of robot, table, and end effector (base pose, table height, pad geometry). A shared initial-state identifier therefore fixes the task’s start, not an identical geometry or an identical first observation. The base benchmark is LIBERO’s four ten-task suites, LIBERO-Spatial, LIBERO-Object, LIBERO-Goal, and LIBERO-10, simulated in MuJoCo ( Todorov et al., 2012 ) through robosuite ( Zhu et al., 2020 ) , each task with 50 fixed initial states, a scene camera, a wrist camera, proprioception, and a nominal control rate of 20 Hz.
blocks.zh: LIBERO-RIG测量一项政策对它所运行的机器人物理参数的扰动程度有多强,任务被固定. 它保留了指令,对象身份,成功的上游,以及每个LIBERO(刘等,2023年)任务的名义初始状态识别符,并只改变钻机,机器人硬件及其设置方式,一次一个轴,设定数量. 钻机的参数是场景和手腕相机的外形和内在特征、相机和手臂之间的校正、控制器的增益和速率、手臂报告状态中的噪声、手臂的底部姿势、桌子高度以及末端效应垫的几何等。 从形式上讲,钻机配置在三地进入了剧集:感知图,政策通过它观察世界(相机起放和相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 因此,共享的初始状态标识符可以确定任务的开始,而不是相同的几何或相同的第一观察。 基准是LIBERO的4个十任务套房,LIBERO-Spatial,LIBERO-Object,LIBERO-Goal,和LIBERO-10,通过robosuite(Zhu等,2020年)在MuJoCo(Todorov等)模拟,每个任务都有50个固定的初始状态,一个场景相机,一个手腕相机,自控,名义控制率为20赫.

blocks.en: Table 22 lists the ten axes used in this paper. The organizing idea is the type column, which classifies each fault by its direct effect on the camera images at a matched arm and object configuration. An observable fault changes at least one camera image of that configuration, as with a moved camera or a shifted robot base. A latent fault changes no camera image; it shows only in a non-visual input or in how the arm responds to a command, as with a rotated calibration or noise on the reported arm pose. Gripper-pad geometry sits between the two, since the pads occupy a few pixels of the wrist view. The split matters for mitigation: image augmentation targets what a policy sees, so by itself it does not address a fault that leaves the image of a given state unchanged. Each axis is a small, exactly specified transform of the simulator model or of the command stream. Action-frame rotation, for example, rotates the commanded translation and rotation about the world vertical before the controller’s scaling and clipping, a controlled proxy for one rotational component of a calibration error.
blocks.zh: 表22列出了本文使用的十轴. 组织理念是类型栏,它通过对相配臂和对象配置相机图像的直接影响来分类每个断层. 一个可观测到的断层至少会改变这个配置的相机图像,就像移动相机或转动的机器人基座一样. 潜在的断层不会改变相机图像;它只显示在非视觉输入或手臂如何响应命令,如在报告的手臂姿势上旋转校正或发出噪音。 Gripper-pad几何坐落在两者之间,因为垫子占据了手腕视图的几像素. 缓解的分出问题:图像增强针对的是政策所看到的,因此它本身并不涉及使特定国家的形象保持不变的过失。 每个轴是模拟器模型或指令流的精确指定的小变换. 例如,在控制器的缩放和剪取之前,将所命令的关于世界的翻译和旋转旋转旋转,这是校正出错的一个旋转组件的控制代用.

blocks.en: Table 22: The ten LIBERO-RIG perturbation axes used in this paper. LIBERO-RIG also defines a control-frequency axis, the control loop running at a rate other than the trained 20 Hz; the code-as-policy harness runs the rig at the nominal rate and cannot apply that fault, so the axis is excluded from every result here. Type: O observable (at least one camera image changes at a matched configuration), L latent (no camera image changes), W weakly observable (visible only in the wrist view at close range). The last column gives the range from the mildest to the severest level.
blocks.zh: 表22:本文使用的10个LIBERO-RIG扰动轴. LIBERO-RIG还定义了控制-频率轴,控制回路运行速度不同于所训练的20Hz;代码-政策控制器以名义速率运行钻机,不能应用该断层,因此轴被排除于这里的每个结果. 类型:O可观测(在匹配配置时至少会有一个相机图像变化),L可潜伏(没有相机图像变化),W可弱可观测(仅可近距离在手腕视图中可见). 最后一栏给出的幅度从最温和到最严.

blocks.en: Every axis has five settings, s1 to s5. For every axis these form a ladder from the smaller tested magnitudes to a rebuilt rig, with the first two levels at 2 and 5 degrees of camera twist and 1 and 2 cm of base displacement; the magnitudes are not claimed to represent measured real-world drift, and a given level does not carry the same physical severity across axes. This paper uses level 3, which we call moderate, throughout: the 18-task course, the T2 re-grades of practiced policies, and every LIBERO-RIG number in the main text are at the moderate level. The one exception is a severity sweep that also grades policies at levels 4 and 5, which we call severe ( Table 12 , Figure 17 , and Table 24 ); each of these labels its level. A condition is one combination of suite, axis, and level, and spans all ten tasks of the suite. Table height applies only to the two suites whose arenas are height-adjustable, so the ten axes give 190 perturbed conditions plus four nominal ones. Every episode’s parameters are pinned in checksummed manifests rather than sampled at run time, and every condition starts its tasks from the same fixed initial states as the unperturbed baseline, so every policy meets the same perturbation on the same start.
blocks.zh: 每个轴有5个设置, s1到 s5. 对于每一轴来说,它们都形成一个梯子,从试验的更小的等分到重建的钻机,前两个等分为相机扭矩的2和5度和基数的1和2厘米;等分不声称代表所测量的现实世界漂移,某一等分在等分等分的轴上不具有同样的物理严重性。 本文使用3级,我们称之为中度,通篇:18级任务课程,T2级已实践政策再分级,正文中每个LIBERO-RIG编号都是中度. 唯一的例外是,在4级和5级的评级政策中也存在严重例外(表12、图17和表24);每个等级都标出其等级。 一个条件就是套房,轴和关卡的组合,并跨出套房的所有十个任务. 桌高只适用于竞技场高可调的两套套套房,因此"十轴"给出了190个扰动条件外加四个名义条件. 每集的参数被固定在核对汇总的表单中,而不是在运行时进行抽样,每个条件都从与未扰基线相同的固定初始状态开始任务,因此每集政策在同一起步时都满足同样的扰动.

blocks.en: The score is the raw success rate under each condition, read against the same policy’s unperturbed rate on the same suite. Raw rates answer the deployment question directly, how often the policy works on this rig, and the gap to the nominal rate is the perturbation cost; a retention companion, the ratio of the two, allows a capability-adjusted reading. Each policy receives a per-axis profile rather than a single number, which tells a practitioner which rig changes it tolerates and which it does not. An episode starts from its fixed initial state, settles for ten control steps under a no-op command, and hands control to the policy; it ends as a success the moment LIBERO’s predicate holds and as a failure when the budget runs out, with the step budget scaled to the control rate so that the simulated-time budget stays constant. The policy receives no fault identity, severity, rate, or calibration metadata, and any hidden state is reset between episodes. Two things must hold for a perturbed condition to measure the policy rather than the benchmark: the task must remain solvable, and its goal must remain visible. LIBERO-RIG tests both with fairness checks, replaying LIBERO’s recorded demonstrations under the exact inverse of the perturbation where an inverse exists, following the demonstration’s path with a closed-loop tracking witness where it does not, and auditing goal visibility along each perturbed camera. The evidence is reported as diagnostics and never used to remove a condition or an episode from the score.
blocks.zh: 得分是每个条件下的原始成功率,比照同一政策在同一套房上的未扰速率阅读. 原始率直接回答部署问题,政策如何在这个钻机上起作用,而与名义率的差距是扰动成本;保留相伴,两者之比,允许能力调整读取. 每项政策都得到一个一轴的剖面图,而不是一个单数,它告诉一个从业者哪些钻机可以改变它,哪些则不能改变它。 片段从固定的初始状态开始,在禁管令下解决了十个控制步骤,并控制了政策;片段结束于LIBERO的上游状态,以及预算用完时的失败,步骤预算缩放到控制率,使模拟时间预算保持不变。 该政策没有获得错误身份,严重性,速率,或校准元数据,任何隐藏状态都会被重置于各集之间. 要衡量政策而不是基准,必须有两样东西,那就是:任务必须仍然可以解决,其目标必须保持可见。 LIBERO-RIG通过公平检查进行测试,重放LIBERO所记录的示威,在反向发生时完全相反, 证据被报告为诊断,从未用于从分数中去除一个病情或一集.

blocks.en: The unit in SEAR is a cell, one task under one condition, rather than a full condition. The LIBERO-RIG course, which a Lineage run takes after LIBERO-PRO in place of RoboLab, is a development course of 18 cells at the moderate level: four or five tasks from each of the four suites, each paired with one perturbation axis, chosen so that all ten axes appear ( Table 23 ); the control-frequency axis is excluded for the reason above. Each cell receives the family’s per-task development budget ( Appendix E ) and is graded on the DEV, VAL, and TEST bands of Appendix D , exactly as an unperturbed LIBERO task would be. The agent is given the stock LIBERO task text with only the task reference changed; nothing in the workspace names the fault. The course is run as three seed-matched runs per model (two for Gemini-3.6-flash, whose donor has two libraries), and the matched Vanilla control runs one 60-minute session per cell, three repetitions, with the same text; its host grades come every 15 minutes (the lineage runs’ every 5), with agent-initiated submissions in both, so readings taken before 30 minutes favor the lineage runs and Section 3.2 quotes the 30-minute mark. The T2 results of Section 4.1 take policies practiced on unperturbed LIBERO and re-grade them, frozen, on all 40 tasks under every axis at the moderate level; the severity sweep adds the two severe levels, and Table 12 gives the per-axis values.
blocks.zh: SEAR中的单元是一个细胞,一个任务在一个条件下,而不是一个完整的条件. LIBERO-RIG课程是LIBERO-PRO取而代之取而代之RoboLab所运行的一门由18个细胞组成的中层发展课程:从4个套房中各出4个或5个任务,每个套房与1个扰轴对接,选择后所有10个轴都出现(表23);由于上述原因,控制频率轴被排除在外. 每个单元都会收到家庭的每个任务发展预算(附录E),并在附录D的DEV、VAL和TEST波段上分级,这与未受干扰的LIBERO任务完全相同。 代理给的股票 LIBERO 任务文本中只更改了任务引用;在工作空间中,没有任何东西给错误取名. 课程以三个种子相匹配的每个模型运行(双子座-3.6-flash, 其捐赠者有两个库), 对应的香草控制每个细胞运行一个60分钟的会话, 重复三次, 文本相同; 其主机成绩每15分钟来一次( 世系每5次), 第4.1节的T2结果采纳了对未扰动的LIBERO实行的政策,并在中度一级对每个轴线下的所有40个任务重新进行分级、冻结;重度扫描增加了两个重度,表12给出了每轴值。

blocks.en: For every developed cell we take the best valid policy a model’s adaptation runs wrote on it and run it, frozen, on every other cell of the same base task: the other axes at the moderate and the two severe levels for Opus and DeepSeek-v4-flash, at the moderate level for the other models. The reference is the same model’s LIBERO-PRO-practiced policy for that task, run frozen on the identical cell (the T2 transfer of Section 4.1 ), so the comparison asks whether practice under one hardware fault helps under a different one. Both sides of the comparison are validation grades, complete grades only, paired on identical cells; the score is the macro over the ten axes of the mean over cells ( Table 24 ). The gain is at most about ten points either way. It is positive for Opus, DeepSeek-v4-flash, and Gemini-3.6-flash, and larger at the severe levels than at the moderate level for Opus. It is negative for GPT-5.6-sol and Kimi-k3.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个发达的细胞,我们采取最佳有效的政策,一个模型的适应性运行在它上,并运行,被冻结,运行在同一基本任务的其他细胞上:其他轴在中度和两个重度的Opus和DeepSeek-v4-flash,在中度的层次运行在其他模型上。 参考的是同一模式的LIBERO-PRO实践政策,该政策在相同的单元格上被冻结(第4.1节的T2转接),因此比较时询问在一个硬件断层下的做法是否有助于另一个单元格。 比较的两边是验证分数,只完成分数,在等同的单元格上进行对等;分数是平均值的十轴上大于单元格的宏(表24. 所得最多十分左右 对奥普斯,DeepSeek-v4-flash,和双子座-3.6-flash来说是正数,在重度水平上大于中度水平的奥普斯. GPT-5.6-sol和Kimi-k3为负数。

blocks.en: The five models differ in strategy as much as in score, and their failure modes follow from their strategies. The portraits below give the counts behind them. All counts are from the Lineage and Vanilla campaigns unless stated.
blocks.zh: 这五个模式在战略上和分数上都有所不同,它们的失败模式都跟随其战略. 下面的肖像画给出了后面的计数. 所有统计都来自线性运动和香草运动,除非说明。

blocks.en: Opus: measure first, build infrastructure, verify by proprioception. Opus makes the most tool calls (196 per two-hour RoboLab run against 101 on a one-hour LIBERO-PRO task, the one model whose effort scales with difficulty), runs the simulator locally, and views six to seven images per run. The looking is diagnostic, not reactive: image views lead to code edits 38% of the time (baseline 24%), concentrate in the second half of its exploration once the pipeline exists, and do not follow failure-flagged results. It compiles what it measured into geometry: only 20% of its RoboLab lineage policies call SAM3 (73% of no-library policies do), and its libraries hold height maps, rim fits, and footprint searches where other models hold SAM3 detector prompts. Its policies verify the grasp by gripper aperture (97%), guard by remaining step budget (98%), and retry (94%), the idioms most strongly associated with success within Opus. It writes the most to the library, five to ten entries per step, phrased as sentences that carry a reason (“measure the hang, do not assume it”), and it is the only model that writes about the harness rather than the robot. It submits the least: half its runs are graded only by auto-evaluation. Its skills are almost uniformly useful (38 of 42 with three or more uses have positive lift, where a skill’s lift is how much more often policies that import it succeed than policies that do not), and its best-of-3 winners lose nothing from validation to test.
blocks.zh: 奥普斯:首先测量,建造基础设施,通过自制验证. Opus在1小时的LIBERO-PRO任务上,用最多的工具调用(196分每2小时RoboLab跑出101分),这个模型在难度下,在本地运行模拟器,每跑查看6到7个图像. 外观是诊断性的,而不是反应性的:图像视图导致代码编辑了38%的时间(基准为24%),一旦管道存在,就集中在下半部的探索中,并且不跟踪被标记出故障的结果. 它将测量到的几何:只有20%的RoboLab分界线政策称为SAM3(无图书馆政策有73%),它的图书馆拥有高地图,相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通 其政策通过抓取孔径(97%),通过剩余的步入预算(98%)和重试(94%)来验证掌握情况。 它向图书馆写得最多,每步有5到10个条目,用句子来表达一个理由(“衡量绞刑,不要假设它”),它是唯一一个写起绳子而不是机器人的模型. 它至少提交了:其一半的运行量仅通过自动评估进行分级。 其技能几乎一致有用(42个中有38个有3个或3个以上用途的人有正升降机,其中技能的升降机是其成功政策比不成功政策多得多),其3个最佳赢家从验证到测试都没有损失。

blocks.en: GPT-5.6-sol: fast, blind, and it overfits VAL. GPT-5.6-sol never reads an image by itself; it saves frames to disk and reasons about them numerically. It makes the fewest tool calls (60, and only 40 on LIBERO-PRO), edits the least (7 files), runs the simulator locally the most (16 to 21 times per run), and submits the most (3.6 times; 90% of its best rounds are its own submissions). It treats SAM3 as a source of candidates rather than ground truth: its bundles carry one or two text prompts at the median, the fewest of any model, but the most geometric filtering (3.1 filters per bundle against 0 to 0.4 for the others, and a color gate in 83% of RoboLab lineage bundles). Half of what it writes to memory is about what SAM3 misses, not how to phrase the prompt. This separation, SAM3 for what is present and code for which object the instruction means, made it the second-best model on RoboLab without a library. Its style is fast or never: 31% of its RoboLab runs succeed by minute 40 and almost none after 100. Three costs follow. It shows the largest VAL-to-TEST gap of any model (4 to 7 points) and 20% of its runs end on a policy worse than their best; its library lowers its RoboLab score ( − 4.5 -4.5 ; Table 5 ), because its skills are task-named suite helpers whose most-used member has negative lift; and with Gemini-3.6-flash it is one of the two models for which best-of-3 beats Vanilla on RoboLab ( Section 3.1 ).
blocks.zh: GPT-5.6-sol:快活,盲活,而且超合VAL. GPT-5.6-sol从不单独读取一幅图像;它从数字上将帧保存到磁盘并保存其原因. 它提供最少的工具呼叫(60个,在LIBERO-PRO上只有40个),编辑最少的(7个文件),在本地运行模拟器最多(每跑16到21次),提交最多(3.6次;其最佳回合的90%是自己的提交). 它将 SAM3 视为候选人的来源而不是地面真理:它的捆绑在中位值上携带一到两个文字提示,是所有模型中最少的,但最几何过滤(其他捆绑每捆有3.1个过滤器对0. 它写给记忆的一半内容是 SAM3 错过了什么,而不是如何表达提示。 这种分离,即SAM3用于当前内容和对指示表示对象的代码,使其成为没有库的RoboLab上的第二好模型. 其作风快或永远不作: 它的RoboLab有31%跑道以40分跑道成功,100分后几乎无一跑道. 接下来是三个成本。 它显示任何模式(4至7分)最大的VAL-TEST差距,以及其20%的运行结束政策比最佳政策差;它的库会降低其RoboLab的得分(-4.5-4.5;表5),因为其技能是任务命名的套房帮手,其使用最多的成员有负升;而用双子座-3.6-闪电是最佳3胜于RoboLab上的Vanilla的两个模式之一(第3.1节)。

blocks.en: Kimi-k3: explores well, ships rarely, learns along the lineage. Kimi-k3 matches or beats Opus on five of seven self-exploration settings ( Table 14 ) and adapts to hardware faults nearly as well as Opus when it has a library (94.4 against 97.0% TEST), but not without one (72.0 against 96.7). Its dominant failure is delivery: 64% of its graded RoboLab rounds never contained a policy file, because it probes the simulator in background processes and runs out of time; in the 40-minute best-of-3 draws, 90% of attempts ship nothing. Its shipped Vanilla policies score a mean 42 VAL, against 63 for Opus, with closed-loop code (aperture check 88%, retry 92%, wrist-camera refinement 77%). It looks at six to eight images per run, late, and edits after 68% of them (baseline 25%), the most corrective use of vision in the study. It is the model whose library gain grows along the lineage ( − 26 -26 points in the first seven steps to + 35 +35 by step 45), whose skills are almost all useful (23 of 24 with three or more uses have positive lift), and the second to carry LIBERO-origin control skills onto the Isaac rig.
blocks.zh: Kimi-k3:探索好,船只很少,沿系学习. Kimi- k3 匹配或击打 Opus在7个自我探索设置中的5个(表14)上,并适应硬件断层几乎以及Opus在拥有库时(94.4对97.0%的TEST),但并非没有1个(72.0对96.7). 其最主要的失败是交付:其分级的RoboLab弹中,64%从未包含过政策文件,因为它在背景过程中探测了模拟器并耗尽了时间;在40分钟最优秀的3分图中,90%的尝试无一载运. 其运送的"香草"(Vanilla)政策得分平均42 VAL,对"Opus"为63分,有闭路码(Aperture check 88%,再试92%,腕相机精细度77%). 它每跑一次看6到8个图像,很晚,在68%的图像后进行编辑(基线为25%),这是研究中最正确的视觉用法. 它的图书收益沿着血统增长(-前7个步骤中的26-26分到+35+35分再第45步),其技能几乎全部有用(24个中有23个有3个或3个以上用途的有正升起),第二个将LIBERO原产控制技能带入Isaac钻机.

blocks.en: DeepSeek-v4-flash: text-only, and it reads the library rather than importing it. Given open-set segmentation and a depth lifter, the one model that cannot see composes them into working manipulation: 98% of its RoboLab policies call SAM3 and lift the mask through the depth camera, with eight distinct prompts per lineage bundle, it ships a policy in 85% of runs (more often than Kimi-k3 or Gemini-3.6-flash), and on RoboLab it is ahead of Gemini-3.6-flash, the multimodal model of the same tier, without and with a library (though not in best-of-3). It writes skills it does not call again (51 to 71% of its skills are never reused, the highest share) and imports library code in few of its policies (14% on robosuite, 19% on LIBERO, 34% on LIBERO-PRO, 20% on RoboLab, against 53 to 100% for the other four models); its library gain on RoboLab is + 4.1 +4.1 TEST points on the 58 tasks its runs completed, and its 18-point gain on LIBERO-PRO, the largest of any model, does not arrive as copied text: the policies that copy the most from the inherited memories score lower (75) than those that copy nothing (87). Its memories are concrete constants (“descend the TCP to top_z − - 0.016 for a 0.028-tall box so the jaws wrap the sides”). Its weakness is what it cannot see: when SAM3 misses it has no fallback, and it trails Gemini-3.6-flash on LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO.
blocks.zh: DeepSeek-v4-flash:只读文本,它读取了库而不是导入. 考虑到开放式的分块和深度升起器,一个无法看到它们构成工作操纵的模型:98%的RoboLab政策称为SAM3,并通过深度相机将口罩抬出,每行包有8个明显的提示,它传送85%跑道的政策(比Kimi-k3或双子座-3.6-flash更常见),在RoboLab上,它领先于双子座-3.6-flash,即同一层的多式模型,没有,而且有一个库(尽管不是最好的3). 它没有再使用技能(其技能的51%至71%从未再使用,是最高份额),并且在其少数政策中进口了图书馆代码(在robosuite(14%),LIBERO(19%),LIBERO-PRO(34%),RoboLab(20%),其他四种模式为53%至100%);在RoboLab(完成的58项任务中,它的图书馆收益是+ 4.1+4.1 TEST(4)分,在LIBERO-PRO(任何模式中最大的一种)上,其18分收益不是作为复制文本而来的:从继承记忆中复制最多的政策得分低于(75分),而不是复制任何(87分)。 它的记忆是混凝土常数(“将TCP分解为顶-z---0.016,一个0.028-托盘的盒子,使下巴将两侧相接”). 它的弱点是它无法看到的:当SAM3错过它时,它没有回落,它追随双子座-3.6-闪烁在LiBERO和LiBERO-PRO上.

blocks.en: Gemini-3.6-flash: shortest policies, one perception route, skills it never reuses. Gemini-3.6-flash writes the shortest policies in the study (median 22 lines on the RoboLab lineages; 153 without a library), edits four times per run, opens an image in 2% of runs, and never runs the simulator locally. SAM3 is its entire perception (39 VAL with it against 2 without), and its adaptation is the prompt: 11 distinct prompts per lineage bundle with synonym lists in 95% of them (“grey bin”, “gray bin”, “plastic bin”, “storage bin”, “container”). Its one strong control habit is polling the success predicate to the end (86% of lineage bundles): 68% of its logged failures end with the motion complete and the jaws closed on air. It authors skills it mostly calls once, and on RoboLab it has called rig methods that do not exist. Its library gain on RoboLab is + 2.0 +2.0 ; its larger gains elsewhere ( + 47 +47 on the LIBERO-RIG course, + 13 +13 on LIBERO-PRO) sit on the cells it fails alone. Its no-policy rounds (38%) are delivery failures upstream of robotics.
blocks.zh: 双子座-3.6-闪电:最短的政策,一种感知路线,它从未再利用的技能. 双子座-3.6-flash写出研究中最短的政策(RoboLab线上中间有22行;153行没有库),每跑会编辑4次,在2%跑会打开一幅图像,从不在当地运行模拟器. SAM3是其整体感觉(39 VAL与2 VAL对无),它的适应是快取:其中95%的每行有同义词清单的有11个不同的快取(“grey bin”、“gray bin”、“塑料 bin”、“存储 bin”、“容器”)。 它的一个强烈的控制习惯是投票成功(86%的血系包):68%的记录失败以运动完成结束,下巴被关闭。 它的作者大多使用过一次,在RoboLab上它使用不存在的钻机方法。 它在RoboLab上的图书馆增益为+2.0+2.0;它在其他地方的较大增益(在LIBERO-RIG课程上为+47+47,在LIBERO-PRO上为+13+13)坐落在它失败的细胞上. 其无政策回合(38%)是机器人上游的交付失败.

blocks.en: Failure by task category (RoboLab Vanilla, validation episodes). Relative placement (stacking, spatial relations) scores 1.7 times each model’s mean; tools and utensils score 28% for Opus, 24 for GPT-5.6-sol, and 3 on average for the other three; reorientation scores 0.29 of each model’s mean and thin or handled objects 0.48. Over 21,552 graded episodes the within-cell rank correlation between a layout’s pass rate and the target’s reach, lateral offset, yaw, or clutter averages 0.04 in magnitude. Where a policy logged its closing aperture, 78% of failed episodes closed on air (under 5 mm) against 18% of successful ones. For Kimi-k3 and Gemini-3.6-flash, 54 and 55% of zero-score runs never delivered a policy file.
blocks.zh: 按任务类别划分的失败(RoboLab Vanilla,验证事件). 相对定位(stacking,space relations)的得分是每个模型的平均值的1.7倍;工具和用具的得分是Opus的28%,GPT-5.6-sol的24分,其他三个平均为3分;方向调整的得分是每个模型的平均值和瘦或被处理的对象的0.48分. 超过21,552个分级的细胞内部的分级关系,一个布局的通过率与目标范围、平面相抵、yaw, 或整齐的大小平均值为0.04。 如果一项政策记录了关闭孔径,78%的故障事件(5毫米以下)在空气中关闭,而成功的事故为18%。 对Kimi-k3和双子座-3.6-flash来说,54%和55%的零分跑从未交付过政策文件.

blocks.en: Verification schools and policy shape. Two verification schools never mix within a model: Opus, Kimi-k3, and DeepSeek-v4-flash test the grasp by gripper aperture after closing (97, 88, and 74%); GPT-5.6-sol and Gemini-3.6-flash test by the environment’s holding flag (92 and 45%). Opus refines from the wrist camera at pre-grasp in 75% of RoboLab lineage bundles and Kimi-k3 in 77%, the other three in 22% on average. The library halves the policy and moves logic into imports: an Opus lineage policy is 293 lines importing 524 lines of skills, a GPT-5.6-sol one 124 plus 256, a Gemini-3.6-flash one 22 plus 137. Open-category selection and multi-object cells are a second source of failure, and stronger models suffer less from it: these cells score 0.83 of the model’s mean for Opus and 0.66 for the others. Success falls monotonically from blocks (81% for Opus) through bananas and bottles to mugs and bowls (55) to tools.
blocks.zh: 核查学校和政策形态。 两所核查学校从未在模型中混合:Opus、Kimi-k3和DeepSeek-v4-flash在关闭后通过抓取孔径测试抓住(97、88和74%);GPT-5.6-sol和双子座-3.6-flash测试由环境控旗测试(92和45%)。 奥普斯从手腕相机上精炼出75%的RoboLab线程捆绑和77%的Kimi-k3,另外三个平均为22%. 图书馆将政策减半,将逻辑移入进口:一种Opus分界线政策是293行进口524行技能,一种GPT-5.6-Sol 1 124+ 256,一种双子座-3.6-flash 1 22+ 137. 开放类选择和多对象细胞是失败的第二个来源,而更强大的模型受失败的影响较少:这些细胞得分为:Opus的模型平均值为0.83分,而其他的则为0.66分. 成功单从块(奥普斯为81%)到香蕉和瓶子到杯子和碗(55个)到工具。

blocks.en: Accumulation mattered more than perturbation. Every model handled LIBERO-PRO’s reworded instructions comparatively well; the harder problem was accumulating useful experience. On the hardest LIBERO-Goal task, Opus scored 0 of 5 with the stock instruction and 2 of 5 after it was rephrased seventeen steps into the LIBERO-PRO curriculum. The drawer, not the wording, was the difficulty, and what differed was the library: 171 entries at the stock run against 262 at the PRO run, including two self-authored skills that did not exist earlier. The comparison is not strictly like for like, since the two scores come from different bands and both runs timed out mid-refactor.

blocks.en: Appendix R Extended Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录R 扩展的相关工作

blocks.en: R.1 Self-evolving Agents
blocks.zh: R.1 自演代理人

blocks.en:
The idea that an agent can improve its own performance through iterative self-evaluation predates the current generation of large language models but has been revitalized by their code-generation capabilities. Shinn et al. (2023) show that an agent can improve across repeated attempts with no weight update at all, by writing reflections on its own failures into an episodic memory that later attempts read. Zelikman et al. (2024) introduce the Self-Taught Optimizer (STOP), which recursively rewrites its own improvement procedure in code, demonstrating that language models can bootstrap increasingly effective optimization strategies without human-designed update rules.
More recently, scaffold engineering has emerged as a complementary axis of self-improvement: rather than modifying model weights, agents evolve the scaffolding code that orchestrates their reasoning and tool use. Weng (2026) provides a comprehensive survey of this paradigm, distinguishing weight-level from scaffold-level improvement and cataloging the design patterns that enable it. Lin et al. (2026a) operationalize the idea by building coding agents that automatically evolve their own harness code through observability-driven feedback loops.
A critical methodological concern is whether observed performance gains truly stem from improved strategies or merely from resampling. Lin et al. (2026b) address this directly, showing that a substantial fraction of apparent self-evolution in LLM agents can be attributed to lucky draws rather than genuine capability acquisition, and propose controlled protocols to disentangle the two.
blocks.zh:
一个代理能够通过迭代自评来提高自身性能的想法早于现在的一代大语言模型,但被其代码生成能力所振兴. Shinn等人(2023年)表明,通过将自己失败的反思写入后来尝试读取的零星记忆中,一个代理可以改进反复尝试,而根本不更新重量. Zelikman等 (2024)引入了"自教优化"(STOP),该"优化"在代码中反复地重写了自己的改进程序,表明语言模型可以在没有人类设计的更新规则的情况下将越来越有效的优化策略拖出脚步.
最近,脚手架工程作为自我改进的互补轴而出现: 代理人不是修改模型重量,而是演化出操控其推理和工具使用的脚手架代码. 文革(2026年)对这一范式进行了全面的调查,将重量级与脚手架级的改进区分开来,并编目了使得它得以实现的设计模式. 林等编. (2026a)通过建立编码代理,通过可观察性驱动的反馈回路,自动地演化出自己的取用代码来将这个想法付诸实施.
一个关键的方法学问题,是观察到的业绩收益是否真正来自改进后的战略,还是仅仅来自重新取样。 Lin等人(2026年b)直接谈到这一点,表明LLM剂中相当一部分明显的自演可以归因于幸运地抽取而不是真正的能力获取,并提出控制协议来分解两者.

blocks.en: R.2 Benchmarks for Autonomous Research Agents
blocks.zh: R.2 自主研究代理的基准

blocks.en:
A parallel line of work develops benchmarks for measuring how well language model agents can conduct end-to-end research and engineering. Chan et al. (2024) introduce MLE-bench, which evaluates agents on Kaggle-style machine learning engineering tasks with automatic grading. Wijk et al. (2025) propose RE-Bench, which measures frontier AI R&D capabilities by asking agents to improve the performance of given ML systems under a time budget, emphasizing the distinction between one-shot coding and iterative self-improvement. Starace et al. (2025) scale the ambition further with PaperBench, which asks agents to replicate full AI research papers from scratch. Rank et al. (2026) focus specifically on post-training: PostTrainBench evaluates whether agents can automate the reward modeling, alignment, and fine-tuning pipeline for language models.
In the embodied domain, Zhu et al. (2026) introduce EdgeBench, which studies scaling laws for agents that learn from real-world interaction.
blocks.zh:
平行的工作路线为衡量语文模型代理人如何进行端到端研究和工程制定基准。 陈等. (2024)引入了MLE-bench,它用自动分级来评价卡格尔式机器学习工程任务的代理. Wijk等 (2025年)提出RE-Bench,通过要求代理商在时间预算下改善给定的ML系统的性能来衡量前沿AI研发能力,强调一发编码和迭代自改进之间的区别. Starace等人(2025年)用"纸本奇"来进一步衡量雄心壮志,它要求特工们从零开始复制完整的AI研究论文. 兰克等. (2026)特别侧重于后培训:后Train Bench评价代理商是否能够将奖励模型自动化,校正,以及语言模型的微调管道.
在所包含领域,朱等. (2026年)引入了"Edge Bench",用于研究从现实世界互动中学习的代理人的缩放定律.

blocks.en: Appendix S Co-Evolving Loop: Extended Proposal
blocks.zh: 附录S 共同演变循环:扩展提案

blocks.en: Experience can enter the system through four complementary pathways ( Figure 14 ). First, the agent consolidates reusable code, procedures, and lessons into its skill and memory libraries. Second, generated policies serve as executable teachers: repeated rollouts produce data for training VLAs or other learned action and world models, with outcome-aware selection, since teachers are imperfect; successful trajectories support imitation, and failures can inform recovery learning. Third, the interaction history (observations, tool calls, program revisions, and outcomes) could provide training signal for the reasoning agent itself, turning simulation or physical interaction into an environment for reinforcement learning over the agent’s decisions. Fourth, the harness through which the agent observes and acts can itself be revised. Our rollout-driven π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} fine-tuning instantiates one connection in this loop; establishing the full cycle requires several rounds in which updated tools return to the agent, its strategy adapts, and the system is evaluated on held-out tasks, with comparisons that freeze individual components to show whether joint adaptation helps beyond updating each component alone.
blocks.zh: 经验可通过四个互补途径进入该系统(图14)。 首先,代理将可重复使用的代码,程序和教训整合到其技能和记忆库中. 第二,产生的政策是可执行的教师:反复推出数据,用于培训VLA或其他学习到的行动和世界模式,并有成果意识的选择,因为教师不完美;成功的轨迹支持模仿,失败可以为恢复学习提供信息。 第三,相互作用历史(观察、工具呼叫、程序修订和结果)可以为推理代理人本身提供训练信号,将模拟或物理相互作用转变成一个强化学习代理人决定的环境。 第四,可以修改代理人观察和行为所用的手段。 我们的推出驱动 ~ 0.5\pi\ 0.5} 微调这个循环中的一环; 建立整个周期需要几轮更新工具返回代理,其战略适应,系统按搁置任务评价, 比较时冻结单个组件, 以显示联合适应是否有助于超越单个组件的更新。

blocks.en: A key step in this loop is segmenting task instructions and collected trajectories into aligned, reusable action units. Rather than distilling an entire long-horizon task into a single behavior, we propose associating shorter trajectory segments with language descriptions of their local objectives. For example, placing a cup on a saucer can be decomposed into grasping the handle, lifting the cup, transporting it above the saucer, lowering it into contact, releasing the gripper, and withdrawing the arm. The reasoning agent or generated program connects these skills, checks their outcomes, and revises the sequence when execution deviates from the plan. Segmentation should therefore reflect meaningful changes in objectives and completion conditions rather than arbitrary temporal boundaries.
blocks.zh: 这个循环的一个关键步骤是将任务指令和所收集的轨迹分解成对齐的可重复使用的动作单元. 我们建议把较短的轨迹段与地方目标的语言描述联系起来。 例如,将杯子放入调料上可以分解为抓取手柄,取出杯子,将杯子运送到调料上方,将杯子降低到接触处,放出抓取器,并取出手臂. 推理代理或生成的程序将这些技能连接起来,检查其结果,并在执行偏离计划时修改序列. 因此,分裂应反映目标和完成条件的有意义的变化,而不是任意的时间限制。

blocks.en: This decomposition establishes a useful division of labor. The language backbone handles long-horizon reasoning, task composition, and recovery decisions, while the action model translates local language-conditioned objectives into smooth, high-frequency, continuous control. The action model can become a generalist across reusable manipulation skills, retaining the feedback responsiveness needed for execution without having to determine the full task strategy. Training on instruction-aligned segments could make experience reusable across tasks that share manipulation components but require different plans. Within the proposed co-evolution loop, the agent can refine both the segmentation and the skill descriptions as it learns which abstractions its action model can execute reliably.
blocks.zh: 这种分解确立了有益的分工. 语言主干处理长相推理,任务构成,以及恢复决定,而行动模型则将本地语言条件化的目标转化为平滑,高频,连续的控制. 行动模式可成为可重复使用的操纵技能的通论者,保留执行所需的反馈响应,而不必确定全面的任务战略. 关于教学协调部分的培训可以使经验在任务中重复使用,这些任务共享操纵部分,但需要不同的计划。 在拟议的共演化循环中,代理人既可以细化分化,也可以细化技能描述,因为它知道其行动模式可以可靠地执行哪些抽象。

blocks.en: The interaction harness itself can also evolve as the agent discovers limitations in how it observes, acts, and learns. Repeated failures may reveal that static images omit important execution events, motivating video feedback or richer temporal traces. Objects falling outside the reachable workspace may motivate explicit safety zones and motion constraints that preserve the conditions for continued practice. Experience can similarly inform tool interfaces, logging, reset procedures, and failure diagnostics. These changes improve the infrastructure through which subsequent policies are developed and executed, complementing updates to skills, memories, and model tools. In SEAR only skills and memories persist between tasks ( Section 2 ); the proposed loop would also carry model weights forward, and a system that can revise its own harness carries one more kind of state, which we would treat on the same grounds. Interaction informs changes to the harness, which in turn changes the evidence and actions available in future rounds. To evaluate this process reliably, harness revisions should be versioned and assessed while keeping final evaluation criteria and protected test information outside the agent’s modification scope.
blocks.zh: 相互作用的利用本身也可以随着物剂发现其观察、行动和学习方面的局限性而演变。 重复的失败可能揭示出静态图像忽略了重要的执行事件,激发了视频反馈或更丰富的时间痕迹. 位于可达到的工作空间以外的物体可能激发明确的安全区和运动限制,从而维持继续作业的条件。 经验同样能够为工具接口、记录、重设程序和故障诊断提供信息。 这些变化改善了制定和执行后续政策的基础设施,补充了技能、记忆和示范工具的更新。 在SEAR中,只有技能和记忆存在于任务之间(第2节);拟议的循环也会带去模型的分量,而一个能够修正自己的被子的系统会带有另一种状态,我们将基于同样的理由对待这种状态. 互动有助于改变利用方式,这反过来又会改变今后各轮可用的证据和行动。 为了可靠地评价这一过程,应修订并评估利用情况,同时将最后评价标准和受保护的测试信息保留在代理人修改范围之外。
